chapters.title: My studies & identity
chapters.subtitle: 身份、专业或工作与日常学习

grammar.title: be 动词：身份、状态与否定
grammar.pattern: I am / You are / It is; am not / isn't / aren't
grammar.note: am/is/are 后接身份、状态、地点；不要在 be 后再加普通动词原形。

examples.en: I'm an engineering student at a local university.
examples.zh: 我是一所本地大学的工科学生。

examples.en: My degree isn't purely about writing code.
examples.zh: 我的学位并不只是学习写代码。

examples.en: Is university life as busy as you expected?
examples.zh: 大学生活有你预期的那么忙吗？

examples.en: Our group projects are a big part of my course.
examples.zh: 小组项目是我课程中很重要的一部分。

examples.en: I'm not particularly keen on memorising definitions without understanding them.
examples.zh: 我不太喜欢不理解就死记定义。

grammar.title: 基础句型：主谓宾与主系表
grammar.pattern: S + V + O / S + V + complement
grammar.note: 先保证句子主干完整，再添加原因、时间和例子；不要用中文的“因为……所以……”直译成双连词。

examples.en: I study how computers process information.
examples.zh: 我学习计算机如何处理信息。

examples.en: Our lecturer explains difficult concepts with practical examples.
examples.zh: 我们的老师通过实际例子讲解难懂的概念。

examples.en: I don't enjoy lessons that are just a list of formulas.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢只是罗列公式的课。

examples.en: The most rewarding part is seeing a project actually work.
examples.zh: 最有成就感的部分是看到项目真的跑起来。

examples.en: What makes a subject interesting to you?
examples.zh: 是什么让一门学科对你来说有趣？

grammar.title: 人称代词、宾格和所有格
grammar.pattern: I / me / my / mine; we / us / our / ours
grammar.note: I 作主语，me 作宾语；my 后要接名词，mine 单独使用。

examples.en: My classmates and I often discuss assignments after lectures.
examples.zh: 我经常和同学在下课后讨论作业。

examples.en: A tutor once gave me advice that changed my approach to learning.
examples.zh: 一位导师曾给过我建议，改变了我的学习方式。

examples.en: Our team divided the work according to everyone's strengths.
examples.zh: 我们团队根据每个人的长处分配任务。

examples.en: That laptop is mine, but the external monitor belongs to my roommate.
examples.zh: 那台笔记本是我的，但外接显示器是室友的。

examples.en: Did your parents influence your choice of major?
examples.zh: 你的父母影响了你选专业吗？

grammar.title: 冠词 a/an/the 与零冠词
grammar.pattern: a/an + 单数可数；the + 特指；零冠词 + 泛指复数/不可数
grammar.note: 专业、学科的泛称一般不用 the；第一次提到一项具体事物常用 a/an。

examples.en: I joined a research project during university.
examples.zh: 我在大学期间参加了一个研究项目。

examples.en: The project taught me more than I expected.
examples.zh: 那个项目教会我的东西比预期更多。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is a fast-moving field.
examples.zh: 人工智能是一个发展非常快的领域。

examples.en: I usually check the course website before class.
examples.zh: 我通常在上课前查看课程网站。

examples.en: An internship can give students a clearer idea of the workplace.
examples.zh: 一段实习能让学生更清楚地了解职场。

grammar.title: 主谓一致与三单 -s
grammar.pattern: he/she/it + works; people work; everyone has
grammar.note: 口语高分仍要求基础准确：everyone/someone/every student 后接单数谓语；people 用复数。

examples.en: My major involves a fair amount of maths.
examples.zh: 我的专业涉及相当多的数学。

examples.en: One interesting class doesn't determine whether a degree is useful.
examples.zh: 一门有趣的课并不能决定整个学位有没有用。

examples.en: Does your university offer many practical modules?
examples.zh: 你的大学提供很多实践课程吗？

examples.en: Most students prefer examples to long theoretical explanations.
examples.zh: 大多数学生比起冗长的理论讲解更喜欢例子。

examples.en: Everyone in our research group has a different responsibility.
examples.zh: 我们研究组的每个人都有不同的职责。

questions: What do you study, and what do you enjoy about it?
Is there a subject you find difficult?
Would you recommend your course to a younger student?
chapters.practice:
SPEAK IT · OWN IT / 本章口语实战：20–30 秒

用 20 秒介绍你的 专业或工作：身份 → 学些什么 → 最喜欢什么（多用自然简单句）。

□ 第 1 轮：只看英文读 3 遍 □ 第 2 轮：盖住原文，换成自己的真实信息 □ 第 3 轮：录音 1 次，找出一个可修正的语法点

chapters.title: Hometown & accommodation
chapters.subtitle: 家乡、迁居与居住环境

grammar.title: there is / there are：存在句
grammar.pattern: There is + 单数/不可数；There are + 复数
grammar.note: 有/没有某物用 there be，比反复说“my hometown has”更自然。

examples.en: There are plenty of green spaces around my hometown.
examples.zh: 我的家乡周边有不少绿地。

examples.en: There isn't much nightlife in some quieter neighbourhoods.
examples.zh: 一些安静的社区夜生活不算丰富。

examples.en: Are there any parks within walking distance of your home?
examples.zh: 你家步行范围内有公园吗？

examples.en: There's a noticeable difference between my hometown and the city where I study.
examples.zh: 我的家乡和我求学的城市之间有明显差异。

examples.en: There aren't as many familiar faces when you move to a new city.
examples.zh: 搬去新城市后就没那么多熟面孔了。

grammar.title: have / has / have got：拥有与特征
grammar.pattern: have / has + object; have got / has got
grammar.note: 描述城市、房间、设备的特征；have got 较口语，但不要在同一句中机械混用。

examples.en: My hometown has a strong connection with the local food industry.
examples.zh: 我的家乡与当地食品行业联系紧密。

examples.en: The city where I study has got a good mix of modern districts and traditional streets.
examples.zh: 我求学的城市既有现代城区，也有传统街巷。

examples.en: My current room doesn't have much storage space.
examples.zh: 我现在的房间储物空间不太够。

examples.en: Have you got a favourite place to relax in the city?
examples.zh: 你在这座城市有最喜欢的放松地点吗？

examples.en: A small balcony would be a nice feature to have.
examples.zh: 有个小阳台会是不错的加分项。

grammar.title: this/that/these/those：指示与对比
grammar.pattern: this/these 近；that/those 远；one/ones 替代
grammar.note: 口语中用 this place / that area / these days 自然承接上下文。

examples.en: This part of town feels quite international.
examples.zh: 城里的这个区域很有国际化氛围。

examples.en: That old street reminds me of family outings.
examples.zh: 那条老街让我想起和家人出游的时光。

examples.en: These buildings don't all look the same.
examples.zh: 这些楼看起来并不是千篇一律的。

examples.en: Do those changes make the city more liveable?
examples.zh: 那些变化让这座城市更宜居了吗？

examples.en: I'd choose the quieter one over the one near the main road.
examples.zh: 我会选更安静的那套，而不是靠主干道的那套。

grammar.title: 地点、时间介词 in/on/at 与常用搭配
grammar.pattern: in a city / on a street / at university; in 2026 / on Monday / at night
grammar.note: 介词高度依赖搭配；把整块词组读熟比记中文对应更有用。

examples.en: I grew up in a small town in an inland region.
examples.zh: 我在一个内陆地区的小镇长大。

examples.en: I spend much of the academic year in a shared flat.
examples.zh: 学年的大部分时间我都住在合租公寓里。

examples.en: We normally meet on campus in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们通常在下午于校园里见面。

examples.en: The supermarket is just across from the entrance.
examples.zh: 超市就在入口正对面。

examples.en: Would you rather live near the station or in a residential area?
examples.zh: 你更想住车站附近还是住宅区？

grammar.title: 比较级与最高级
grammar.pattern: -er / more ... than; the -est / the most; as ... as
grammar.note: 避免“more better”；比较对象要可比。用 a bit / much / far 增加自然度。

examples.en: The city where I study is much bigger than the town I grew up in.
examples.zh: 我求学的城市比我长大的小镇大得多。

examples.en: The older part of town is more atmospheric than the shopping district.
examples.zh: 老城区比购物区更有氛围。

examples.en: A crowded neighbourhood isn't always less convenient.
examples.zh: 人口密集的街区不一定就更不方便。

examples.en: Which city has the most reliable public transport?
examples.zh: 哪座城市的公共交通最可靠？

examples.en: My hometown is not as fast-paced as some larger cities.
examples.zh: 我的家乡不像一些大城市那样节奏快。

questions: Where is your hometown, and what's it like?
How is the city where I study different from my hometown?
What would you change about your accommodation?
chapters.practice:
SPEAK IT · OWN IT / 本章口语实战：20–30 秒

用 20 秒对比我的家乡与我求学的城市：两座城市各一项特点 + 一句比较级。

□ 第 1 轮：只看英文读 3 遍 □ 第 2 轮：盖住原文，换成自己的真实信息 □ 第 3 轮：录音 1 次，找出一个可修正的语法点

chapters.title: Routines & time
chapters.subtitle: 工作、学习与日常节奏

grammar.title: 一般现在时：习惯与事实
grammar.pattern: I usually do; he often does; don't / doesn't; Do you...?
grammar.note: 讲规律性行为、事实和喜好；不是“现在正在做”的意思。

examples.en: I usually review my notes after a technical lecture.
examples.zh: 上完技术类课程后我通常会复习笔记。

examples.en: I don't check every notification while I'm studying.
examples.zh: 我学习时不会每条通知都看。

examples.en: How often do you work on group assignments?
examples.zh: 你多久做一次小组作业？

examples.en: My day often starts with a quick look at my timetable.
examples.zh: 我的一天通常从快速查看课表开始。

examples.en: A clear plan helps me avoid leaving everything until the last minute.
examples.zh: 清晰的计划能帮我避免事事拖到最后一刻。

grammar.title: 一般现在时疑问句与否定句
grammar.pattern: Do/Does + S + V?; S + don't/doesn't + V
grammar.note: 一定记住 does 后动词回原形，不能说 Does he studies。

examples.en: Do you prefer studying alone or with friends?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢独自学习还是和朋友一起？

examples.en: My timetable doesn't stay the same every week.
examples.zh: 我的时间表不是每周都一样。

examples.en: What do you normally do between classes?
examples.zh: 你平时课间做什么？

examples.en: My classmates don't always agree on how to split the tasks.
examples.zh: 同学们对如何分工并不总是意见一致。

examples.en: Does having a deadline make you more productive?
examples.zh: 有截止日期会让你效率更高吗？

grammar.title: 频率副词与时间表达
grammar.pattern: always / usually / often / sometimes / hardly ever / never
grammar.note: 频率副词常放在实义动词前、be 后；never 本身否定，不能再加 don't。

examples.en: I occasionally practise speaking English on my way to campus.
examples.zh: 我偶尔会在去校园的路上练英语口语。

examples.en: I hardly ever finish a difficult coding task on the first try.
examples.zh: 棘手的编程任务我几乎从不一次就完成。

examples.en: My routine changes quite a lot during exam season.
examples.zh: 到了考试季，我的日常节奏变化很大。

examples.en: Do you ever set aside time just to do nothing?
examples.zh: 你会专门留时间什么都不做吗？

examples.en: I'm usually more focused in the early evening.
examples.zh: 我通常在傍晚更能集中注意力。

grammar.title: 现在进行时：正在发生与暂时安排
grammar.pattern: am/is/are + V-ing; not ...; Are you ...?
grammar.note: 用于说话时、这段时间的临时行为；区别于一般现在时的长期习惯。

examples.en: I'm currently working on a project involving image-generation models.
examples.zh: 我目前正在做一个涉及图像生成模型的项目。

examples.en: I'm not taking any extra language classes this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期我没有额外上语言课。

examples.en: Are you preparing for anything important at the moment?
examples.zh: 你现在正在为某件重要的事做准备吗？

examples.en: More students are using AI tools to organise their study materials.
examples.zh: 越来越多学生在用人工智能工具整理学习资料。

examples.en: I'm trying to make my spoken English sound less rehearsed.
examples.zh: 我正在努力让自己的英语口语听起来没那么像背稿。

grammar.title: 状态动词与现在简单/进行时对照
grammar.pattern: know / believe / prefer / own (通常不用进行时)
grammar.note: I know 而非 I'm knowing；但 I'm thinking about... 是“正在考虑”，语义不同。

examples.en: I know the basics, but I still need more speaking practice.
examples.zh: 我懂基本知识，但仍需要更多口语练习。

examples.en: I don't believe longer study sessions are always better.
examples.zh: 我不认为学习越久就一定越好。

examples.en: I'm thinking about changing the way I revise vocabulary.
examples.zh: 我正考虑改变复习词汇的方法。

examples.en: Do you prefer a fixed routine or a flexible one?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢固定作息还是灵活安排？

examples.en: I understand the theory, although applying it takes practice.
examples.zh: 我理解理论，但应用起来还需要练习。

questions: What does a typical weekday look like for you?
Do you prefer planning ahead or being spontaneous?
Has your daily routine changed since starting university?

chapters.title: Food, shopping & money
chapters.subtitle: 饮食、购物与消费习惯

grammar.title: 可数、不可数与复数
grammar.pattern: an apple / two apples; advice, information, equipment 不可数
grammar.note: 口语常错：an advice / informations / equipments 均不规范。

examples.en: I often grab a sandwich when my schedule is packed.
examples.zh: 行程排得很满时，我常会随手买个三明治。

examples.en: Good advice can save you a lot of time.
examples.zh: 好建议能为你节省很多时间。

examples.en: I don't buy much expensive equipment unless I really need it.
examples.zh: 除非真有需要，我不会买很多昂贵设备。

examples.en: How many meals do you usually cook for yourself?
examples.zh: 你通常自己做几顿饭？

examples.en: I check product reviews before buying electronics.
examples.zh: 买电子产品前我会先看商品评价。

grammar.title: some/any/no 与复合不定代词
grammar.pattern: some / any; someone / anyone / nobody
grammar.note: 疑问句请求或主动提供可以用 some：Would you like some...?

examples.en: I always keep some snacks in my bag during long days.
examples.zh: 日程很长的日子里我总会在包里放些零食。

examples.en: There isn't any fresh fruit left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱里没有新鲜水果了。

examples.en: Would you like some tea before we leave?
examples.zh: 我们出门前你想喝点茶吗？

examples.en: Someone recommended a small noodle shop near campus.
examples.zh: 有人推荐了学校附近的一家小面馆。

examples.en: Nobody in my flat wants to wash up after a big meal.
examples.zh: 在我们住处，大餐过后没人想洗碗。

grammar.title: much/many/a lot of/few/little
grammar.pattern: many + 可数复数; much + 不可数; a few/a little 正向
grammar.note: few/little 常含“太少”语气，a few/a little 则表示“有一些”。

examples.en: I spend quite a lot of time comparing prices online.
examples.zh: 我花不少时间在网上比价。

examples.en: I don't drink much coffee after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我不太喝咖啡。

examples.en: A few good recommendations are more useful than hundreds of ratings.
examples.zh: 几条靠谱推荐比几百条评分更有用。

examples.en: There is very little room for impulse purchases in a student budget.
examples.zh: 学生预算里给冲动消费留的空间很少。

examples.en: Do many people your age still shop in physical stores?
examples.zh: 你这个年纪的人还有很多会去实体店购物吗？

grammar.title: 动名词与不定式：喜欢、计划、避免
grammar.pattern: enjoy/avoid + V-ing; want/plan/decide + to V
grammar.note: 先按动词记搭配，而不是所有动词都强行套 to do 或 doing。

examples.en: I enjoy trying dishes that I wouldn't normally cook at home.
examples.zh: 我喜欢尝试那些平时不会在家做的菜。

examples.en: I try to avoid spending money just because something is on sale.
examples.zh: 我尽量避免只因打折就花钱。

examples.en: I'm planning to cook more often when I have a lighter timetable.
examples.zh: 等课表没那么满时，我打算多自己做饭。

examples.en: Have you ever considered learning to bake?
examples.zh: 你考虑过学烘焙吗？

examples.en: Choosing a reliable seller matters more than finding the lowest price.
examples.zh: 选靠谱卖家比找到最低价更重要。

grammar.title: 礼貌请求与提议
grammar.pattern: Could you...? / Would you mind V-ing...? / Shall we...?
grammar.note: Could 比 Can 往往更委婉；Would you mind 后接 V-ing。

examples.en: Could you recommend something that isn't too spicy?
examples.zh: 你能推荐一道不太辣的菜吗？

examples.en: Would you mind splitting the bill evenly?
examples.zh: 你介意我们平摊账单吗？

examples.en: I'd rather order a smaller portion than waste food.
examples.zh: 我宁愿点小份也不想浪费食物。

examples.en: Shall we compare the prices before making a decision?
examples.zh: 我们要不要先比一下价格再决定？

examples.en: Is it all right if I pay by card?
examples.zh: 我刷卡付钱可以吗？

questions: Do you prefer home-cooked meals or eating out?
How do you decide whether something is worth buying?
Have your shopping habits changed recently?

chapters.title: Phones, internet & AI tools
chapters.subtitle: 科技工具与上网习惯

grammar.title: 现在完成时：经历、影响与结果
grammar.pattern: have/has + past participle; haven't; Have you...?
grammar.note: 过去发生但与现在相关，或不说具体过去时间；have gone / have been 区别。

examples.en: I've used AI tools to organise complex lecture notes.
examples.zh: 我用过人工智能工具整理复杂的课堂笔记。

examples.en: I haven't found a single app that does everything well.
examples.zh: 我还没找到一个样样都做得好的应用。

examples.en: Have you ever lost an important file?
examples.zh: 你有丢失过重要文件吗？

examples.en: Technology has changed the way I learn new skills.
examples.zh: 技术已经改变了我学习新技能的方式。

examples.en: My phone has become a tool for both work and relaxation.
examples.zh: 我的手机已成为工作和放松两用的工具。

grammar.title: ever/never：是否有过某种经历
grammar.pattern: Have you ever V3? / I've never V3.
grammar.note: never 已带否定；回答“从未”不说 I haven't never。

examples.en: Have you ever used a map app in an unfamiliar city?
examples.zh: 你在陌生城市用过地图软件吗？

examples.en: I've never bought a phone on the day it was released.
examples.zh: 我从没在手机发布当天就买过。

examples.en: Has a website ever made a difficult task much easier for you?
examples.zh: 有没有一个网站让某项难事变简单了？

examples.en: I've never been particularly interested in flashy app animations.
examples.zh: 我一直不怎么热衷于花哨的应用动画。

examples.en: The most useful tools I've ever tried are usually quite simple.
examples.zh: 我用过最有用的工具往往都很简单。

grammar.title: already/yet/just 与位置
grammar.pattern: have already V3 / haven't V3 yet / have just V3
grammar.note: yet 常在疑问和否定句末，already 多在助动词后，just 表示刚刚。

examples.en: I've already backed up the files for our group project.
examples.zh: 我已经备份了小组项目的文件。

examples.en: I haven't installed the latest update yet.
examples.zh: 我还没安装最新的更新。

examples.en: Have you checked whether the link works yet?
examples.zh: 你检查过链接是否能用了吗？

examples.en: I've just realised that I left my charger at home.
examples.zh: 我刚发现自己把充电器忘在家里了。

examples.en: The developers have already fixed the bug I reported.
examples.zh: 开发者已经修复了我反馈的那个漏洞。

grammar.title: for/since：从过去持续到现在
grammar.pattern: have V3 for + 时长 / since + 起点
grammar.note: for three years / since 2023；持续状态可说 have lived，不能随意用 have started for。

examples.en: I've lived away from my hometown for several years.
examples.zh: 我已经离开家乡生活好几年了。

examples.en: I've been interested in computer systems since I started university.
examples.zh: 自从上大学我就对计算机系统很感兴趣。

examples.en: I haven't used that old account for ages.
examples.zh: 我已经好久没用那个旧账号了。

examples.en: How long have you had your current laptop?
examples.zh: 你现在这台笔记本用了多久？

examples.en: Some of my interests have remained the same since childhood.
examples.zh: 我的一些兴趣从小到大没怎么变。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时：持续投入与未完事项
grammar.pattern: have/has been + V-ing; haven't been; Have you been...?
grammar.note: 强调持续进行的过程；完成时强调结果，完成进行时强调过程和时长。

examples.en: I've been experimenting with different ways of practising pronunciation.
examples.zh: 我一直在尝试不同的发音练习方法。

examples.en: I haven't been sleeping particularly late this week.
examples.zh: 这周我并没有睡得特别晚。

examples.en: Have you been using that note-taking app for long?
examples.zh: 你用那个笔记软件很久了吗？

examples.en: My research group has been collecting sample data for a new experiment.
examples.zh: 我们研究组一直在为新实验收集样本数据。

examples.en: I've been relying less on translation when I speak English.
examples.zh: 我说英语时越来越少依赖先翻译。

questions: Which digital device do you use the most?
Have you tried any AI tools for your studies?
What kind of websites do you usually visit?

chapters.title: Friends, family & teamwork
chapters.subtitle: 家人、朋友与团队合作

grammar.title: 一般过去时：过去发生的事件
grammar.pattern: V-ed / irregular V2; was / were
grammar.note: 讲过去具体经历，时间已结束；规则和不规则动词都要能脱口而出。

examples.en: I joined my first major team project in university.
examples.zh: 我在大学参加了自己的第一个重要小组项目。

examples.en: A classmate showed me a faster way to debug the program.
examples.zh: 一位同学教了我一种更快的调试方式。

examples.en: I didn't enjoy every group meeting, but I learned from them.
examples.zh: 我并非喜欢每场小组会，但从中学到了东西。

examples.en: Did your family encourage you to study engineering?
examples.zh: 家人鼓励过你学工程吗？

examples.en: My view of education changed as I became more independent.
examples.zh: 随着变得更加独立，我对教育的看法也改变了。

grammar.title: 过去否定句和疑问句 did
grammar.pattern: didn't + V; Did + S + V?
grammar.note: did 出现后实义动词必须回原形：didn't went 错，应是 didn't go。

examples.en: I didn't realise how important communication was at first.
examples.zh: 一开始我没意识到沟通有多重要。

examples.en: Did you make friends easily in your first year?
examples.zh: 你大一时交朋友容易吗？

examples.en: We didn't finish the presentation as early as we hoped.
examples.zh: 我们没能像希望的那样早完成演示文稿。

examples.en: Why did you choose to work with that group?
examples.zh: 你为什么选了和那组人合作？

examples.en: I did learn to ask for help instead of struggling alone.
examples.zh: 我确实学会了求助，而不是一个人硬扛。

grammar.title: 过去进行时：过去某时正在做
grammar.pattern: was/were + V-ing; wasn't; Were you...?
grammar.note: 给故事铺背景，或描述过去特定时刻正在进行的动作。

examples.en: I was working on a deadline when a friend called me.
examples.zh: 朋友给我打电话时，我正在赶截止日期。

examples.en: We weren't paying enough attention to the small details.
examples.zh: 当时我们没有足够重视细节。

examples.en: What were you doing when you received the good news?
examples.zh: 你收到好消息时正在做什么？

examples.en: My teammates were discussing the design while I was testing the code.
examples.zh: 我测试代码时，队友们正在讨论设计。

examples.en: Everyone was looking for a solution, so nobody blamed anyone else.
examples.zh: 大家都在找解决办法，因此没人相互指责。

grammar.title: 一般过去 vs 过去进行：背景与打断
grammar.pattern: was V-ing when V2; while was V-ing, ...
grammar.note: when 常引出短动作，while 常强调同时进行的背景；重点是事件关系。

examples.en: I was reviewing a report when I noticed a missing figure.
examples.zh: 我在检查报告时发现有张图缺失。

examples.en: While we were preparing the demo, the software suddenly crashed.
examples.zh: 我们准备演示时，软件突然崩溃了。

examples.en: I wasn't listening to music when the lecturer asked me a question.
examples.zh: 老师提问时，我没有在听音乐。

examples.en: Were you still living at home when you started preparing for university?
examples.zh: 开始准备上大学时你还住家里吗？

examples.en: My friend sent me a message as I was leaving the library.
examples.zh: 我刚离开图书馆时，朋友给我发了消息。

grammar.title: used to / would：过去的习惯
grammar.pattern: used to V; didn't use to V; Did you use to V?
grammar.note: used to 可表旧状态和习惯；would 主要叙述反复过去动作，不直接表旧状态。

examples.en: I used to think that grades were the main measure of success.
examples.zh: 我以前认为成绩是衡量成功的主要标准。

examples.en: I didn't use to speak up much in group discussions.
examples.zh: 以前我在小组讨论中不怎么发言。

examples.en: Did you use to spend more time playing outside as a child?
examples.zh: 你小时候比现在花更多时间在外面玩吗？

examples.en: Before big exams, I would draw up detailed revision schedules.
examples.zh: 大考前，我总会制定详细的复习计划。

examples.en: My parents used to remind me to take schoolwork seriously.
examples.zh: 父母过去常提醒我要认真对待学业。

questions: Are you still in touch with your childhood friends?
Do you enjoy working in teams?
What have you learned from your family?

chapters.title: Travel & transport
chapters.subtitle: 坐车、出行与旅行计划

grammar.title: will：即时决定、预测与承诺
grammar.pattern: will / won't + V; Will you...?
grammar.note: will 不等于所有将来；即兴决策、承诺、判断可优先用它。

examples.en: I'll take the train if it saves me the hassle of driving.
examples.zh: 如果坐火车能省去开车的麻烦，我就坐火车。

examples.en: I won't book a hotel without checking its location first.
examples.zh: 不先看酒店位置我不会订。

examples.en: Do you think more people will travel by high-speed rail?
examples.zh: 你觉得将来会有更多人坐高铁出行吗？

examples.en: I'll send you the route once I work it out.
examples.zh: 我研究好路线就发给你。

examples.en: I doubt self-driving cars will solve every traffic problem.
examples.zh: 我不认为自动驾驶汽车能解决所有交通问题。

grammar.title: be going to：事先打算与有迹象的预测
grammar.pattern: am/is/are going to + V
grammar.note: 事先有计划/明确证据；和 will 的区别是语境，不必机械绝对化。

examples.en: I'm going to check the train schedule before the weekend.
examples.zh: 我打算周末前查好火车时刻表。

examples.en: I'm not going to carry three bags for a short trip.
examples.zh: 短途旅行我不打算拎三个包。

examples.en: Are you going to visit your hometown during the next break?
examples.zh: 下次假期你打算回家乡吗？

examples.en: The sky is getting darker; it looks like it's going to rain.
examples.zh: 天越来越暗，看起来要下雨了。

examples.en: My friends are going to explore a different neighbourhood this time.
examples.zh: 我朋友们这次打算去逛一个不同的街区。

grammar.title: 现在进行时表示已安排的将来
grammar.pattern: am meeting / are leaving + future time
grammar.note: 多用于已经有安排的计划；与 going to 相比，安排感更强。

examples.en: I'm meeting a classmate at the station tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我明早要在车站见一位同学。

examples.en: We aren't staying overnight; it's just a day trip.
examples.zh: 我们不住一晚，只是当天往返。

examples.en: Are you travelling anywhere during the university break?
examples.zh: 学校假期你打算去什么地方旅行吗？

examples.en: Our group is visiting the lab on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们小组周五要去实验室。

examples.en: I'm taking an earlier train so I can avoid the rush.
examples.zh: 我要坐一趟更早的车，避开高峰。

grammar.title: 一般现在时表示固定时刻表
grammar.pattern: The train leaves at... / The shop opens at...
grammar.note: 公开时刻表、长期固定的时间安排，即使未来也常用一般现在时。

examples.en: The first bus leaves before six in the morning.
examples.zh: 首班公交车早上六点前就发车。

examples.en: The museum opens at ten on weekdays.
examples.zh: 博物馆工作日上午十点开门。

examples.en: The last train doesn't stop at every small station.
examples.zh: 末班车不是每个小站都停。

examples.en: What time does your flight arrive?
examples.zh: 你的航班几点到？

examples.en: Our winter break starts after the exams, so travelling is easier then.
examples.zh: 我们寒假在考试结束后开始，那时出游更方便。

grammar.title: 第一条件句与将来时间从句
grammar.pattern: If + present, will + V; when/as soon as + present, future
grammar.note: 条件/时间从句中通常不用 will：If it rains, we'll stay in。

examples.en: If the traffic is heavy, I'll use the metro instead.
examples.zh: 如果堵车，我就改坐地铁。

examples.en: I won't go out until I finish this section of the assignment.
examples.zh: 做完作业这一部分前我不会出门。

examples.en: What will you do if your train is delayed?
examples.zh: 如果火车晚点你会怎么办？

examples.en: As soon as I reach the station, I'll check the platform number.
examples.zh: 我一到车站就会查看站台号。

examples.en: Unless it gets too late, we'll stop for dinner on the way.
examples.zh: 除非时间太晚，我们会在路上停下来吃晚饭。

questions: How do you usually travel around your city?
Do you enjoy long train journeys?
Is there a trip you're planning?

chapters.title: Hobbies, media & culture
chapters.subtitle: 兴趣、影视与休闲

grammar.title: -ed 与 -ing 形容词
grammar.pattern: interested / interesting; bored / boring
grammar.note: -ed 常描述感受者，-ing 常描述引发感受的事物。

examples.en: I'm fascinated by videos that explain complicated ideas simply.
examples.zh: 我很着迷于那些把复杂概念讲简单的视频。

examples.en: A well-made documentary can be surprisingly entertaining.
examples.zh: 一部制作精良的纪录片可以意外地好看。

examples.en: I'm not interested in films that rely entirely on special effects.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢完全依赖特效的电影。

examples.en: What kind of music do you find relaxing?
examples.zh: 你觉得哪类音乐听起来放松？

examples.en: I felt exhausted after a long day, so I watched something light.
examples.zh: 忙了一天我很累，就看了点轻松的东西。

grammar.title: 程度副词与语气调整
grammar.pattern: quite / rather / fairly / pretty / incredibly + adj
grammar.note: 口语里 naturally hedge：pretty good、a bit dull；avoid endless 'very very'。

examples.en: I'm pretty selective about the channels I follow.
examples.zh: 我对关注哪些频道还是挺挑的。

examples.en: Some short videos are genuinely informative.
examples.zh: 有些短视频确实很有信息量。

examples.en: I wasn't particularly impressed by the ending.
examples.zh: 结局没给我留下特别深的印象。

examples.en: Do you find live performances more exciting than recordings?
examples.zh: 你觉得现场演出比录播更激动人心吗？

examples.en: The podcast was a little too technical for a casual listener.
examples.zh: 对普通听众来说，这个播客有点太专业了。

grammar.title: 限定性定语从句 who/which/that
grammar.pattern: a person who... / a film that... / a tool which...
grammar.note: 用于具体说明“哪一个”；口语中宾语关系代词常可省略。

examples.en: I like creators who can make science accessible to everyone.
examples.zh: 我喜欢能把科学讲得人人都懂的创作者。

examples.en: The film that impressed me most had a very simple plot.
examples.zh: 最打动我的那部电影情节其实很简单。

examples.en: I rarely finish a book that fails to hold my attention.
examples.zh: 如果一本书抓不住我的注意力，我很少能看完。

examples.en: Is there a website which you visit almost every day?
examples.zh: 有没有一个你几乎每天都访问的网站？

examples.en: I still remember the song we played during a school event.
examples.zh: 我还记得学校活动时我们放过的那首歌。

grammar.title: whose/where/when：关系词扩展
grammar.pattern: a person whose... / a place where... / a time when...
grammar.note: whose 表示所属；where/when 引出地点或时间的从句，不只是“那个地方”的重复。

examples.en: I admire people whose hobbies have turned into meaningful careers.
examples.zh: 我欣赏那些把爱好发展成有意义事业的人。

examples.en: A library is somewhere I can concentrate without distractions.
examples.zh: 图书馆是我能不受干扰专心的地方。

examples.en: I remember a time when I was obsessed with puzzle games.
examples.zh: 我记得有段时间自己特别沉迷解谜游戏。

examples.en: Is there a café where you enjoy reading?
examples.zh: 有没有一家你喜欢去看书的咖啡馆？

examples.en: The director whose work I admire tends to tell quiet, personal stories.
examples.zh: 我欣赏的那位导演通常讲述安静、私人化的故事。

grammar.title: 非限定性定语从句与补充说明
grammar.pattern: noun, which/who... , ...
grammar.note: 逗号内是附加信息；不可随便用 that；which 可概括前句整体情况。

examples.en: I bought a pair of headphones, which made commuting more enjoyable.
examples.zh: 我买了一副耳机，通勤时变得更惬意了。

examples.en: My university, which is near a river, has an international atmosphere.
examples.zh: 我的大学位于一条河流附近，有国际化氛围。

examples.en: One of my lecturers, who has worked abroad, often shares practical stories.
examples.zh: 我有位曾在国外工作的老师，经常分享实用经历。

examples.en: The series didn't live up to the reviews, which was a shame.
examples.zh: 那部剧没达到评价里的水准，挺可惜的。

examples.en: The exhibition was free, which encouraged more students to visit.
examples.zh: 展览免费，这也吸引了更多学生前去参观。

questions: What do you like watching in your free time?
Do you prefer short videos or full-length documentaries?
Is there a book, film or song you remember well?

chapters.title: Health, sport & wellbeing
chapters.subtitle: 运动、健康与生活平衡

grammar.title: can/could/be able to：能力与可能
grammar.pattern: can V / could V / have been able to V
grammar.note: can 没有标准完成式，用 have been able to；could 可表过去通常能力。

examples.en: I can focus for longer when my desk is tidy.
examples.zh: 桌面整洁时我能更长时间保持专注。

examples.en: I can't concentrate if there's loud music in the background.
examples.zh: 背景音乐很吵时我没法集中注意力。

examples.en: Could you swim when you were a child?
examples.zh: 你小时候会游泳吗？

examples.en: I've been able to manage my time better since university.
examples.zh: 上大学后我更能管理好自己的时间了。

examples.en: A short walk can make a stressful day feel more manageable.
examples.zh: 短暂散步能让压力很大的一天变得没那么难熬。

grammar.title: should/ought to 与建议语气
grammar.pattern: should / shouldn't / ought to + V
grammar.note: 建议不是命令；I suppose / probably / might want to 能更柔和。

examples.en: Students should take regular breaks instead of staring at a screen all day.
examples.zh: 学生应该定时休息，而不是整天盯着屏幕。

examples.en: You shouldn't sacrifice sleep just to gain one more hour of revision.
examples.zh: 不该为了多复习一小时而牺牲睡眠。

examples.en: Should schools teach young people how to deal with stress?
examples.zh: 学校该教年轻人应对压力吗？

examples.en: I probably ought to spend less time sitting at my desk.
examples.zh: 我可能确实该减少久坐的时间。

examples.en: I'd suggest starting with a routine you can actually maintain.
examples.zh: 我建议先从能真正坚持的习惯做起。

grammar.title: must / have to / mustn't：义务和禁止
grammar.pattern: must V / have to V / mustn't V
grammar.note: mustn't = 禁止；don't have to = 不必，两者意思截然不同。

examples.en: I have to balance coursework with research responsibilities.
examples.zh: 我得平衡课程作业和科研任务。

examples.en: You mustn't ignore safety rules when using laboratory equipment.
examples.zh: 使用实验设备时绝不能忽视安全规则。

examples.en: Do you have to get up early for most of your classes?
examples.zh: 你多数课都得早起吗？

examples.en: On busy days, I have to be realistic about what I can finish.
examples.zh: 忙的时候，我必须现实地判断自己能做完什么。

examples.en: People must realise that rest is part of being productive.
examples.zh: 人们必须意识到休息也是高效的一部分。

grammar.title: don't have to / needn't / be allowed to
grammar.pattern: don't have to V; needn't V; be allowed to V
grammar.note: 不必、无需与不被允许要明确区分。

examples.en: You don't have to train for an hour to stay reasonably active.
examples.zh: 想保持一定活动量并不需要每次锻炼一小时。

examples.en: We aren't allowed to bring drinks into some laboratories.
examples.zh: 有些实验室不允许带饮料进去。

examples.en: Are students allowed to use the gym late at night?
examples.zh: 学生晚上很晚还能使用健身房吗？

examples.en: I needn't take my laptop when I only have a short meeting.
examples.zh: 只是开个短会时，我不必带电脑。

examples.en: It's nice not to have to follow a strict schedule at weekends.
examples.zh: 周末不必遵循严格时间表挺好的。

grammar.title: may/might/could：不确定性与婉转推测
grammar.pattern: may/might/could + V
grammar.note: 口语 7.5+ 常需要控制确定程度，而不是每句都说 definitely。

examples.en: A ten-minute break might help you reset your attention.
examples.zh: 休息十分钟可能有助于重新集中注意力。

examples.en: A fitness app may not be useful if you never open it.
examples.zh: 如果你从来不打开健身软件，那它可能没用。

examples.en: Could flexible working hours improve people's wellbeing?
examples.zh: 弹性工时可能改善人们的幸福感吗？

examples.en: I might join a sports club if my timetable becomes lighter.
examples.zh: 如果课程安排宽松些，我可能会参加运动社团。

examples.en: What works for one person may not work for everyone.
examples.zh: 对一个人有效的方法未必对所有人都有效。

questions: Do you think you have a healthy routine?
How do you relax after a long day?
Would you like to become more physically active?

chapters.title: Nature & the environment
chapters.subtitle: 环保、天气和能源

grammar.title: 一般时态被动语态
grammar.pattern: am/is/are + V3; was/were + V3
grammar.note: 侧重行动对象；不知道/不需提执行者时常用被动。

examples.en: A lot of waste is generated by single-use packaging.
examples.zh: 一次性包装会产生大量废弃物。

examples.en: The local park was renovated a few years ago.
examples.zh: 当地公园几年前翻修过。

examples.en: Not every environmental problem is caused by individuals.
examples.zh: 不是每个环境问题都由个人造成。

examples.en: Is rubbish separated in your neighbourhood?
examples.zh: 你住的社区会进行垃圾分类吗？

examples.en: Some energy-saving measures are introduced gradually.
examples.zh: 有些节能措施是逐步推行的。

grammar.title: 进行时、完成时被动
grammar.pattern: is being V3 / has been V3 / had been V3
grammar.note: 关注事情“正被做/已经被做”；避免把完成时和被动语序写反。

examples.en: More charging points are being installed around the city.
examples.zh: 城市里正在安装更多充电桩。

examples.en: The problem hasn't been solved completely.
examples.zh: 这个问题尚未被彻底解决。

examples.en: Has the new recycling scheme been introduced yet?
examples.zh: 新的回收方案已经推行了吗？

examples.en: The research data had been cleaned before we ran the analysis.
examples.zh: 我们做分析前，研究数据已经清洗过。

examples.en: Several older buildings are being fitted with better insulation.
examples.zh: 一些老建筑正在加装更好的保温设施。

grammar.title: 情态动词被动
grammar.pattern: should/must/can/might + be + V3
grammar.note: 讨论公共建议和政策十分常用；不要写 should be do。

examples.en: Household energy use can be reduced with simple changes.
examples.zh: 通过简单改变就可以减少家庭能源消耗。

examples.en: Environmental costs shouldn't be ignored when products are priced.
examples.zh: 定价时不应忽视环境成本。

examples.en: Should public transport be subsidised more heavily?
examples.zh: 公共交通是否应该获得更多补贴？

examples.en: Reliable data must be collected before policies are evaluated.
examples.zh: 评估政策前必须收集可靠数据。

examples.en: Certain materials might be recycled more efficiently in the future.
examples.zh: 某些材料未来可能被更高效地回收。

grammar.title: get + V3：事件性被动
grammar.pattern: get damaged / get caught / get repaired
grammar.note: get-passive 常比 be-passive 更口语，强调事情发生、意外或变化。

examples.en: My umbrella got damaged in a sudden storm.
examples.zh: 我的伞在一场突如其来的暴风雨中坏了。

examples.en: Some trees got blown down by strong winds.
examples.zh: 一些树被大风刮倒了。

examples.en: Reusable bags don't get thrown away after a single trip.
examples.zh: 可重复使用的袋子不会用一次就扔。

examples.en: Do bikes often get stolen near busy stations?
examples.zh: 繁忙车站附近的自行车经常被偷吗？

examples.en: Food gets wasted when people buy more than they need.
examples.zh: 人们买得超过需求时，食物就被浪费了。

grammar.title: have/get something done：请人处理
grammar.pattern: have/get + object + V3
grammar.note: 表请人完成事情：I had my laptop repaired，不是“我亲自修”。

examples.en: I had my bike checked before a long ride.
examples.zh: 长途骑行前我让人检查了自行车。

examples.en: We got the air conditioner serviced before summer.
examples.zh: 夏天来之前我们找人保养了空调。

examples.en: I wouldn't have my phone repaired at an unreliable shop.
examples.zh: 我不会把手机送去不靠谱的店修。

examples.en: Have you ever had your passport photo taken professionally?
examples.zh: 你曾找专业人员拍过证件照吗？

examples.en: My friend got a broken zipper replaced instead of buying a new bag.
examples.zh: 我朋友选择换掉坏拉链，而不是买新包。

questions: Do you enjoy spending time outdoors?
Is recycling common where you live?
What can people do to waste less energy?

用 30 秒讨论节能：被动语态 2 句 + should be done 1 句。

□ 第 1 轮：只看英文读 3 遍 □ 第 2 轮：盖住原文，换成自己的真实信息 □ 第 3 轮：录音 1 次，找出一个可修正的语法点

chapters.title: Career, learning & ambitions
chapters.subtitle: 未来职业与持续学习

grammar.title: 过去完成时：过去的过去
grammar.pattern: had + V3; hadn't; Had you...?
grammar.note: 两个过去事件：先发生的常用 had V3；没必要每个过去动作都用过去完成。

examples.en: By the time the meeting started, I had read the relevant papers.
examples.zh: 开会之前，我已经读完了相关论文。

examples.en: I hadn't worked with that software before the internship.
examples.zh: 实习之前我没用过那款软件。

examples.en: Had you considered another major before choosing engineering?
examples.zh: 选工科前你考虑过其他专业吗？

examples.en: I realised that I had misunderstood one of the requirements.
examples.zh: 我意识到自己之前误解了一项要求。

examples.en: The team had tested several approaches before settling on one.
examples.zh: 团队在确定一种方法前测试过多种方案。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时：持续到过去某一点
grammar.pattern: had been + V-ing
grammar.note: 强调过去某时之前一直在进行的活动，多用于故事交代背景。

examples.en: I'd been studying the algorithm for hours before it finally made sense.
examples.zh: 我研究那种算法好几个小时后才终于弄懂。

examples.en: We hadn't been using that dataset for long when we found an issue.
examples.zh: 发现问题时，我们用那套数据还没多久。

examples.en: How long had you been preparing before the interview began?
examples.zh: 面试开始前你准备了多久？

examples.en: The developers had been fixing bugs all week, so they looked exhausted.
examples.zh: 开发者整周都在修漏洞，所以看起来很疲惫。

examples.en: I'd been thinking about postgraduate study long before I started applying.
examples.zh: 我早在开始申请前很久就在考虑读研了。

grammar.title: 将来进行时：未来特定时间正在做
grammar.pattern: will be + V-ing; won't be; Will you be...?
grammar.note: 表示在未来某时进行的活动，也用于较礼貌地询问安排。

examples.en: This time next year, I may be studying for a master's degree.
examples.zh: 明年这个时候，我可能正在攻读硕士学位。

examples.en: I won't be working on the same assignment forever.
examples.zh: 我不会永远都在做同一个作业。

examples.en: Will you be using the lab tomorrow afternoon?
examples.zh: 明天下午你会使用实验室吗？

examples.en: In a few years, engineers will be working with much more capable AI systems.
examples.zh: 再过几年，工程师将使用能力更强的人工智能系统。

examples.en: I'll be looking for roles that combine research with practical engineering.
examples.zh: 我会寻找结合研究和实际工程的岗位。

grammar.title: 将来完成时：截至某未来时点完成
grammar.pattern: will have + V3; won't have; Will you have...?
grammar.note: by + 未来时间点；说目标结果；不建议在短回答里频繁硬塞。

examples.en: By the time I graduate, I'll have completed several substantial projects.
examples.zh: 毕业时，我将已经完成数个较大的项目。

examples.en: I probably won't have mastered every programming language by then.
examples.zh: 到那时我大概还无法掌握所有编程语言。

examples.en: Will you have finished your application by the end of the month?
examples.zh: 到月底时你会完成申请吗？

examples.en: In five years, many routine tasks will have become more automated.
examples.zh: 五年后，很多常规任务将已经变得更自动化。

examples.en: I hope I'll have gained experience in both research and industry.
examples.zh: 我希望届时自己已积累科研和行业两方面的经验。

grammar.title: 将来完成进行时：未来时点的持续时长
grammar.pattern: will have been + V-ing + for...
grammar.note: 较少见，掌握识别和自然使用即可；高分不需要刻意炫技。

examples.en: By next autumn, I'll have been studying engineering for several years.
examples.zh: 到明年秋天，我学工科就已经好几年了。

examples.en: By the end of the project, we'll have been working together for nearly a year.
examples.zh: 项目结束时，我们合作就将接近一年了。

examples.en: I won't have been living in the same city for my whole adult life.
examples.zh: 到那时，我并不是整个成年生活都住在同一座城市。

examples.en: By December, how long will you have been preparing for the exam?
examples.zh: 到十二月你备考这场考试就有多久了？

examples.en: By the time I retire, I'll have been learning new technologies for decades.
examples.zh: 到退休时，我就已经连续几十年在学习新技术了。

questions: What kind of career would you like to pursue?
What new skill are you learning at the moment?
Do you think your goals will change over time?
chapters.practice:
SPEAK IT · OWN IT / 本章口语实战：20–30 秒

谈真实职业目标：过去准备、现在状态、未来预期各一句。

chapters.title: Childhood, festivals & memorable moments
chapters.subtitle: 童年、节日与记忆

grammar.title: 现在完成时与一般过去时的时间界限
grammar.pattern: I've visited... / I visited ... last year
grammar.note: 有具体已结束时间（last year / in 2024）优先过去时；经历与现状连接可用完成时。

examples.en: I've visited Shanghai several times over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年我去过上海好几次。

examples.en: I went there for a short trip last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我去那里短途旅行过一次。

examples.en: I haven't been back to that childhood playground recently.
examples.zh: 我最近没有回过儿时那个游乐场。

examples.en: When did you last celebrate a festival with your relatives?
examples.zh: 你上次和亲戚一起过节是什么时候？

examples.en: Family celebrations have become more meaningful to me as I've grown older.
examples.zh: 随着长大，家庭庆祝活动对我越来越有意义。

grammar.title: be used to / get used to + V-ing
grammar.pattern: be used to + noun / V-ing; get used to + V-ing
grammar.note: 不是 used to V（过去常常）；be used to doing = 已习惯。

examples.en: I'm used to managing my own timetable at university.
examples.zh: 我已经习惯在大学自己安排时间。

examples.en: I wasn't used to speaking English every day at first.
examples.zh: 一开始我不习惯每天说英语。

examples.en: How long did it take you to get used to living away from home?
examples.zh: 你花了多久才适应离家生活？

examples.en: I gradually got used to doing presentations in front of others.
examples.zh: 我逐渐习惯在别人面前做展示。

examples.en: Some people never get used to the noise of a busy city.
examples.zh: 有些人始终无法适应繁忙城市的噪音。

grammar.title: so ... that / such ... that：程度与结果
grammar.pattern: so + adj/adv + that; such + (a/an) + adj + noun + that
grammar.note: so 后接形容词/副词；such 后接名词性词组。

examples.en: The celebration was so lively that I lost track of time.
examples.zh: 庆祝活动热闹得让我忘了时间。

examples.en: It was such a thoughtful gift that I still keep it.
examples.zh: 那是一份很贴心的礼物，我至今留着。

examples.en: The room wasn't so crowded that we couldn't move.
examples.zh: 房间还没挤到没法走动的程度。

examples.en: Have you ever heard a story that was so funny you couldn't stop laughing?
examples.zh: 你听过好笑到让你笑个不停的故事吗？

examples.en: I was so relieved when the exams ended that I slept for most of the afternoon.
examples.zh: 考试一结束我太如释重负了，下午大半时间都在睡觉。

grammar.title: too ... to / ... enough to
grammar.pattern: too + adj + to V; adj + enough + to V
grammar.note: too ... to 常表过度而做不到；enough 在形容词后、名词前。

examples.en: The childhood photo is too blurry to make out everyone's face.
examples.zh: 那张童年照片太模糊，看不清每个人的脸。

examples.en: I'm old enough to appreciate how much my parents did for me.
examples.zh: 我现在足够成熟，能理解父母为我做了多少。

examples.en: We weren't organised enough to leave on time.
examples.zh: 我们准备得不够有条理，没能按时出发。

examples.en: Was the party too noisy for people to have a proper conversation?
examples.zh: 聚会是不是吵到大家没法好好聊天？

examples.en: The tradition is simple enough for young children to take part in.
examples.zh: 这个传统活动足够简单，小孩子也能参与。

grammar.title: because / so / although / but：基础复合句
grammar.pattern: because + clause; although + clause, main clause
grammar.note: 避免 because...so... 和 although...but... 同句双连词。

examples.en: I enjoy the Spring Festival because it brings relatives together.
examples.zh: 我喜欢春节，因为它让亲戚有机会团聚。

examples.en: Although our family members live in different places, we try to stay in touch.
examples.zh: 虽然家人住在不同地方，我们仍尽量保持联系。

examples.en: I didn't buy a new outfit, as I already had something suitable.
examples.zh: 我没买新衣服，因为本来就有合适的。

examples.en: Do you prefer big celebrations, or do you like quiet gatherings?
examples.zh: 你喜欢盛大的庆祝活动还是安静的小聚？

examples.en: I was tired after the journey, but it was worth seeing everyone.
examples.zh: 路上挺累，但能见到大家很值得。

questions: What celebrations are important to your family?
What do you miss about your childhood?
Do you enjoy giving or receiving gifts?

chapters.title: A person who influenced me
chapters.subtitle: 影响自己的老师、同事或导师

grammar.title: 叙事时间线：at first / later / eventually
grammar.pattern: at first → after a while → eventually; by the time...
grammar.note: 不是语法时态本身，而是支撑复杂叙事的时间衔接；配合过去时使用。

examples.en: At first, I found the research topic rather intimidating.
examples.zh: 起初，我觉得研究主题有些令人望而生畏。

examples.en: After a few meetings, I began to understand the main idea.
examples.zh: 开过几次会后，我开始理解核心思路。

examples.en: Meanwhile, our supervisor encouraged us to test our assumptions.
examples.zh: 与此同时，导师鼓励我们检验自己的假设。

examples.en: Eventually, I became much more confident in discussing technical work.
examples.zh: 最后，我对讨论技术工作自信多了。

examples.en: Looking back, the biggest change was in how I approached problems.
examples.zh: 回头看，最大的变化是我处理问题的方式。

grammar.title: 宾语关系代词的省略
grammar.pattern: the advice (that) she gave me / the person (who) I met
grammar.note: 关系代词充当宾语时多可省略，口语更流畅；做主语时不能随便删。

examples.en: One piece of advice I remember is to question my assumptions.
examples.zh: 我记得的一条建议是质疑自己的先入之见。

examples.en: The teacher I admired most was patient with difficult questions.
examples.zh: 我最敬重的那位老师很有耐心地回答难题。

examples.en: The example he used made the whole concept click.
examples.zh: 他用的例子让我一下子理解了整个概念。

examples.en: The approach we tried first didn't produce reliable results.
examples.zh: 我们最先尝试的方法没得出可靠结果。

examples.en: The skills I picked up have helped me well beyond that module.
examples.zh: 当时学到的技能对我之后的帮助远不止那门课。

grammar.title: 强调助动词 do/did
grammar.pattern: I do believe... / I did enjoy...
grammar.note: do/did + 动词原形表达真诚强调，适度使用；不必每句都加。

examples.en: I do appreciate teachers who make time for students.
examples.zh: 我确实很感激愿意花时间帮助学生的老师。

examples.en: I did struggle at the beginning, but I kept asking questions.
examples.zh: 我一开始确实很吃力，但一直坚持提问。

examples.en: I don't always agree with my supervisor, but I respect his reasoning.
examples.zh: 我并非总赞同导师的观点，但尊重他的推理。

examples.en: The feedback did help me spot a flaw in my argument.
examples.zh: 那份反馈确实帮我看出了论证中的漏洞。

examples.en: Do you ever look back and realise how much someone helped you?
examples.zh: 你是否有时回想起来，才意识到别人帮了你多少？

grammar.title: 强调句 It was ... that/who ...
grammar.pattern: It was X that/who did Y
grammar.note: 强调人物、时间、地点或事件原因；自然强调关键转折，不要机械加长。

examples.en: It was my first failed experiment that taught me to be patient.
examples.zh: 正是第一次失败的实验教会我耐心。

examples.en: It was a lecturer who first sparked my interest in this field.
examples.zh: 最早激发我对这个领域兴趣的是一位老师。

examples.en: It wasn't the grade that mattered most to me in the end.
examples.zh: 到最后，对我最重要的并不是分数。

examples.en: Was it that conversation that changed your mind?
examples.zh: 是那次谈话改变了你的想法吗？

examples.en: It was during a group project that I began to value communication more.
examples.zh: 正是在一次小组项目中，我开始更加重视沟通。

grammar.title: What 从句作主语/表语焦点
grammar.pattern: What I learned was... / What matters is...
grammar.note: 用 what 概括一整件事；谓语单复数按意义安排，别过量重复。

examples.en: What impressed me most was his ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
examples.zh: 最打动我的是他能把复杂想法讲清楚。

examples.en: What I needed at the time was honest feedback, not praise.
examples.zh: 我当时需要的是诚实反馈，而不是夸奖。

examples.en: What made the course useful wasn't the textbook alone.
examples.zh: 让课程有价值的不只是教材。

examples.en: What was it about that person that inspired you?
examples.zh: 那个人究竟有什么地方启发了你？

examples.en: What stayed with me was the idea that mistakes are part of learning.
examples.zh: 一直留在我脑海里的是：犯错也是学习的一部分。

questions: Describe a teacher or mentor who had an influence on you.
How did that person help you?
Why do you still remember them?

SPEAK IT · OWN IT / 本章口语实战：90–120 秒

按‘之前—转折—后来—现在’讲导师/老师，重点练 what-clause。

□ 第 1 轮：只看英文读 3 遍 □ 第 2 轮：盖住原文，换成自己的真实信息 □ 第 3 轮：录音 1 次，找出一个可修正的语法点

chapters.title: A difficult problem I solved
chapters.subtitle: 一次真实的挑战与解决过程

grammar.title: 第三条件句：与过去事实相反
grammar.pattern: If + had V3, would/could/might have V3
grammar.note: 讨论“当时如果……结果本可以……”，千万别写 if I would have。

examples.en: If I'd checked the input earlier, I would have saved several hours.
examples.zh: 如果我早点检查输入数据，本可以省下好几个小时。

examples.en: We wouldn't have spotted the bug if we hadn't compared the outputs.
examples.zh: 如果当时没对比输出，我们就发现不了那个漏洞。

examples.en: Would you have tried a different method if you had had more time?
examples.zh: 如果当时有更多时间，你会尝试别的方法吗？

examples.en: I might have given up if a teammate hadn't offered a fresh perspective.
examples.zh: 如果队友没提供新视角，我当时可能就放弃了。

examples.en: Had we documented the changes properly, the problem would have been easier to trace.
examples.zh: 如果我们当时正确记录了改动，追踪问题就会容易得多。

grammar.title: should/could/might have done：过去评价
grammar.pattern: should have V3 / could have V3 / might have V3
grammar.note: should have 往往含后悔或批评；could have 表当时本有可能。

examples.en: I should have tested the small components separately.
examples.zh: 我当时应该分别测试小模块。

examples.en: I shouldn't have assumed the dataset was clean.
examples.zh: 我当时不该想当然地认为数据是干净的。

examples.en: We could have asked for feedback a day earlier.
examples.zh: 我们本可以早一天征求反馈。

examples.en: Could you have handled the situation more calmly?
examples.zh: 你当时本可以更冷静地处理那件事吗？

examples.en: The error might have come from an outdated library.
examples.zh: 问题可能来自一个过时的软件库。

grammar.title: wish + 过去完成时：对过去的遗憾
grammar.pattern: I wish I had V3 / If only I had V3
grammar.note: wish + had V3 是“希望过去不同”，不能用 wish I would have 表同一意思。

examples.en: I wish I'd kept a clearer record of each experiment.
examples.zh: 我真希望当时把每次实验都记录得更清楚。

examples.en: I wish we hadn't changed two settings at the same time.
examples.zh: 我真希望当时没有同时改两个设置。

examples.en: If only I'd asked that question sooner, I could have avoided confusion.
examples.zh: 要是我早些问那个问题就好了，能避免很多困惑。

examples.en: Do you ever wish you'd handled a disagreement differently?
examples.zh: 你是否偶尔希望当时换一种方式处理争执？

examples.en: I wish I'd been more patient with myself when progress was slow.
examples.zh: 进展缓慢时，我真希望当时能对自己更有耐心。

grammar.title: 混合条件句：过去原因、现在结果
grammar.pattern: If + had V3, would V now
grammar.note: 过去不同→现在不同，尤其适合成长与反思。

examples.en: If I hadn't joined the project, I wouldn't be so interested in perception systems now.
examples.zh: 如果当时没参加这个项目，我现在可能不会对感知系统这么感兴趣。

examples.en: If I'd chosen a different degree, my career plans would look very different today.
examples.zh: 如果我当初选了别的学位，现在的职业规划会完全不同。

examples.en: I wouldn't feel this confident if I hadn't practised presenting my work.
examples.zh: 如果没练习过展示研究成果，我现在不会这么自信。

examples.en: Would you be as organised today if you hadn't faced that deadline?
examples.zh: 如果没经历过那次截止日期，你今天还会这么有条理吗？

examples.en: If we had ignored the warnings, the system might still be unreliable.
examples.zh: 如果我们当时忽略了警告，系统如今可能仍不可靠。

grammar.title: 让步与转折：even though / despite
grammar.pattern: even though + clause; despite + noun/V-ing
grammar.note: 尽管有困难仍采取行动。despite 后面不要直接接完整句子。

examples.en: Even though our first approach failed, we learned a great deal from it.
examples.zh: 尽管第一种方法失败了，我们仍从中学到很多。

examples.en: Despite working late, we couldn't finish the integration that evening.
examples.zh: 尽管忙到很晚，那天晚上我们仍没能完成集成。

examples.en: The project wasn't a waste of time, even though the results were mixed.
examples.zh: 尽管结果参差不齐，项目也不是白做。

examples.en: Would you take the same risk again despite the difficulties?
examples.zh: 尽管有困难，你还会再冒同样的风险吗？

examples.en: In spite of the setback, the whole team remained optimistic.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇挫折，整个团队依然保持乐观。

questions: Describe a difficult problem you eventually solved.
What made it challenging?
What did you learn from it?

chapters.title: A place I would recommend
chapters.subtitle: 自己熟悉并愿意推荐的地点

grammar.title: 现在分词短语作后置定语
grammar.pattern: people living nearby / a path leading to...
grammar.note: V-ing 短语紧接修饰对象，表示主动/进行；别产生悬垂修饰。

examples.en: The path leading to the lake is lined with trees.
examples.zh: 通往湖边的小路两旁种满了树。

examples.en: People living nearby often come here for a quiet walk.
examples.zh: 住在附近的人常来这里散步。

examples.en: A café overlooking the canal would be a lovely place to read.
examples.zh: 一家能俯瞰运河的咖啡馆会是很棒的阅读地点。

examples.en: The buildings surrounding the square aren't all newly constructed.
examples.zh: 广场周围的建筑并不全是新建的。

examples.en: The students studying in the library seemed completely absorbed in their work.
examples.zh: 图书馆里学习的学生看起来十分投入。

grammar.title: 过去分词短语作后置定语
grammar.pattern: a bridge built in... / houses painted white
grammar.note: V3 多表被动或完成，适合描述建筑、场所与设计。

examples.en: The bridge built over the narrow stream is especially pretty at sunset.
examples.zh: 架在窄溪上的那座桥日落时尤其漂亮。

examples.en: The park renovated last year now has wider paths.
examples.zh: 去年翻修的公园如今有了更宽的步道。

examples.en: The murals displayed on the wall weren't created by professional artists.
examples.zh: 墙上展示的壁画并非出自专业艺术家之手。

examples.en: Have you visited any buildings designed by well-known architects?
examples.zh: 你参观过知名建筑师设计的建筑吗？

examples.en: The photos taken from the rooftop capture the whole neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 从屋顶拍的照片能把整个街区尽收眼底。

grammar.title: 分词状语：Walking / Having ...
grammar.pattern: Walking through..., I noticed... / Having finished..., I ...
grammar.note: 逻辑主语必须与主句一致；难度较高但适合自然的故事表达。

examples.en: Walking along the canal, I noticed how quiet the area was.
examples.zh: 沿运河散步时，我注意到这一带格外安静。

examples.en: Having spent most of the week indoors, I appreciated the fresh air.
examples.zh: 一周大部分时间都待在室内之后，我格外珍惜新鲜空气。

examples.en: Not knowing the area well, I asked a local for directions.
examples.zh: 因为不太熟悉这片区域，我向当地人问了路。

examples.en: Surrounded by old houses, the courtyard feels surprisingly peaceful.
examples.zh: 这座院子被老房子环绕，出奇地宁静。

examples.en: Looking back at the photos, I realised how much I had missed.
examples.zh: 回看照片时，我才意识到自己漏看了多少东西。

grammar.title: with + 名词 + 补足语
grammar.pattern: with the sun setting / with its doors open / with ... done
grammar.note: 用来补充现场背景或状态，口语叙事很有效。

examples.en: With the lights reflecting on the water, the street looked beautiful.
examples.zh: 灯光倒映在水面上，整条街漂亮极了。

examples.en: With a train station nearby, the area is easy to reach.
examples.zh: 附近有火车站，去这一带很方便。

examples.en: With so many people around, it wasn't exactly peaceful.
examples.zh: 周围人太多，其实谈不上安静。

examples.en: With the main road closed, we had to take a different route.
examples.zh: 主干道封了，我们只好绕路。

examples.en: With its windows facing south, the room gets plenty of daylight.
examples.zh: 房间窗户朝南，采光非常好。

grammar.title: 同位语与精确名词短语
grammar.pattern: my hometown, a city in... / my colleague, a researcher...
grammar.note: 通过插入简短定义让考官理解陌生地点，不必长篇解释。

examples.en: My hometown, a small inland town, has a very different pace of life.
examples.zh: 我的家乡是一座内陆小镇，生活节奏很不一样。

examples.en: The university library, one of my regular study spots, is usually busy.
examples.zh: 大学图书馆是我常学习的地方之一，通常很热闹。

examples.en: We visited a small exhibition space, a former factory building.
examples.zh: 我们参观了一个小型展览空间，原先是一座厂房。

examples.en: The old town, a popular tourist area, isn't always crowded on weekdays.
examples.zh: 老城是个热门旅游区，但工作日并不总拥挤。

examples.en: The central courtyard, the heart of the complex, is where people gather.
examples.zh: 中央庭院是建筑群的中心，人们常在那里聚集。

questions: Describe a place you would recommend to a visitor.
What does it look and feel like?
Why is it special to you?

chapters.title: A trip or special day
chapters.subtitle: 一次出行、活动或特别的日子

grammar.title: 直接引语与间接引语基础
grammar.pattern: She said, '...' → She said (that) ...
grammar.note: 复述别人的话时不必硬背原句；注意人称、时间视角和时态。

examples.en: My friend said that the museum was worth visiting.
examples.zh: 朋友说那家博物馆值得一去。

examples.en: The guide told us that the building used to be a school.
examples.zh: 导览员告诉我们，这栋楼以前是所学校。

examples.en: My cousin didn't say that the trip would take so long.
examples.zh: 表亲并没有说这趟行程要这么久。

examples.en: Did anyone tell you where to meet?
examples.zh: 有人告诉你在哪里集合吗？

examples.en: I remember saying that we should leave a little earlier.
examples.zh: 我记得当时说过我们应该早点出发。

grammar.title: say / tell / ask 的结构
grammar.pattern: say something; tell somebody something; ask somebody to V
grammar.note: 不能说 tell to me（常规语境应 tell me）；ask sb to do 用于请求。

examples.en: The receptionist told me to keep the ticket until the end.
examples.zh: 前台人员让我把票保留到最后。

examples.en: I asked a staff member whether photography was allowed.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员是否允许拍照。

examples.en: Nobody told us about the road closure in advance.
examples.zh: 事先没人告诉我们道路封闭的事。

examples.en: What did the driver say when you asked about the delay?
examples.zh: 你询问晚点原因时，司机怎么说？

examples.en: A local suggested taking the quieter route along the river.
examples.zh: 一位当地人建议走沿河那条更安静的路。

grammar.title: 间接疑问句：陈述语序
grammar.pattern: Do you know where it is? / I wonder if...
grammar.note: 不能说 Do you know where is it?；间接疑问句使用陈述语序。

examples.en: Could you tell me where the nearest station is?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我最近的车站在哪里吗？

examples.en: I wasn't sure whether the last bus had already left.
examples.zh: 我不确定末班车是否已经开走。

examples.en: I don't know why the train was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我不知道那趟火车为何取消。

examples.en: I wondered how long it would take to get there.
examples.zh: 我当时想知道到那里要花多久。

examples.en: Do you remember what time the show started?
examples.zh: 你记得演出几点开始吗？

grammar.title: 过去将来时 would / was going to
grammar.pattern: said I would V; was going to V, but...
grammar.note: 在过去时间点谈“当时的未来”；讲计划如何改变很有用。

examples.en: I thought the trip would be exhausting, but it was actually relaxing.
examples.zh: 我原以为旅程会很累，结果反而很放松。

examples.en: We were going to have lunch outdoors, but it started raining.
examples.zh: 我们本打算在室外吃午饭，但下起雨来。

examples.en: I didn't realise the exhibition would close so early.
examples.zh: 我没想到展览会这么早结束。

examples.en: Did you know you were going to meet someone you hadn't seen in years?
examples.zh: 你当时知道自己将见到多年未见的人吗？

examples.en: The organiser promised that the event would finish on time.
examples.zh: 组织者保证活动会准时结束。

grammar.title: be about to / on the point of：即将发生
grammar.pattern: be about to V / be on the point of V-ing
grammar.note: 叙事中的临界一刻；通常和 when 引出突发转折。

examples.en: We were about to leave when someone suggested taking a group photo.
examples.zh: 我们正要走时，有人提议合影。

examples.en: I was on the point of giving up when the map finally loaded.
examples.zh: 我正准备放弃时，地图终于加载出来了。

examples.en: The performance wasn't about to start, so we still had time for tea.
examples.zh: 演出还没马上开始，所以我们还有时间喝茶。

examples.en: Were you about to board when the announcement came?
examples.zh: 广播响起时你正准备登车吗？

examples.en: Just as I was about to order, I noticed a dish I'd never tried.
examples.zh: 就在我准备点餐时，我看见一道从未尝试过的菜。

questions: Describe a journey or day that didn't go exactly to plan.
What changed during the day?
How did you react?

chapters.title: A useful invention or device
chapters.subtitle: 日常设备与有用的发明

grammar.title: make / let / have 使役结构
grammar.pattern: make/let/have + sb + V
grammar.note: 主动结构后用动词原形：make me think；被动 be made to V 例外。

examples.en: A good keyboard makes long writing sessions more comfortable.
examples.zh: 好键盘能让长时间打字更舒服。

examples.en: My parents let me make most of my own academic decisions at university.
examples.zh: 上大学后，父母让我自己决定大多数学业事务。

examples.en: I wouldn't let an unfamiliar app access all my private files.
examples.zh: 我不会允许不熟悉的应用访问我所有私人文件。

examples.en: Does using a tablet make it easier to take notes?
examples.zh: 用平板会让记笔记更容易吗？

examples.en: The tutorial had us install the software before the workshop.
examples.zh: 教程要求我们在工作坊前安装软件。

grammar.title: get / help / encourage + sb + to do
grammar.pattern: get/encourage sb to V; help sb (to) V
grammar.note: get sb to do = 设法让某人做；help 后 to 可省。

examples.en: My teammate helped me understand how the sensor worked.
examples.zh: 队友帮我理解了传感器的工作方式。

examples.en: A lecturer encouraged us to compare the results carefully.
examples.zh: 一位老师鼓励我们仔细比较结果。

examples.en: It's hard to get everyone to switch to a new platform overnight.
examples.zh: 很难让所有人一夜之间转用新平台。

examples.en: What first got you interested in artificial intelligence?
examples.zh: 最早是什么让你对人工智能产生兴趣？

examples.en: A clear interface helps beginners get started without feeling lost.
examples.zh: 清晰的界面能帮新手不迷茫地入门。

grammar.title: 感官动词 see/hear + V / V-ing
grammar.pattern: see sb do (全过程) / doing (进行中的片段)
grammar.note: 两种结构重点不同；感官动词被动通常接 to V。

examples.en: I watched the robot move across the test area.
examples.zh: 我看着机器人穿过测试区域。

examples.en: I saw a technician checking the equipment before the demo.
examples.zh: 我看到技术人员在演示前检查设备。

examples.en: I didn't hear the warning sound because I was wearing headphones.
examples.zh: 因为戴着耳机，我没听见警报声。

examples.en: Have you ever seen a self-driving vehicle park itself?
examples.zh: 你见过自动驾驶汽车自己停车吗？

examples.en: I noticed the screen flickering whenever the cable moved.
examples.zh: 我注意到线缆一动，屏幕就闪烁。

grammar.title: stop / remember / try + V-ing vs to V
grammar.pattern: stop doing / stop to do; remember doing / remember to do
grammar.note: doing 与 to do 的意思可能完全不同：stop smoking ≠ stop to smoke。

examples.en: I stopped checking my phone so frequently during study sessions.
examples.zh: 我不再在学习时频繁看手机。

examples.en: We stopped to check the navigation system before turning.
examples.zh: 我们停下来检查导航系统，然后才转弯。

examples.en: I remember installing the program, but I can't find the folder.
examples.zh: 我记得自己装过程序，但找不到文件夹了。

examples.en: Don't forget to save your work before restarting the computer.
examples.zh: 重启电脑前别忘了保存工作。

examples.en: If the app keeps freezing, try clearing the cache.
examples.zh: 如果应用一直卡住，可以试试清理缓存。

grammar.title: 目的不定式与不定式后置修饰
grammar.pattern: to V / in order to V / something to V
grammar.note: 简洁解释“为了什么”；to do 修饰某人要做的事情也常见。

examples.en: I bought an external drive to back up my research files.
examples.zh: 我买了一块移动硬盘来备份科研文件。

examples.en: We ran a quick test in order to rule out a hardware issue.
examples.zh: 我们做了一个快速测试，以排除硬件故障。

examples.en: This isn't a device to buy just because it looks impressive.
examples.zh: 这不是仅凭外观惊艳就值得买的设备。

examples.en: What features do you look for when choosing a new laptop?
examples.zh: 选新笔记本时，你会关注哪些功能？

examples.en: I need a reliable way to keep track of different experiment settings.
examples.zh: 我需要一种可靠的方法记录不同实验设置。

questions: Describe a device or invention you find useful.
How did you start using it?
How has it changed your life?

chapters.title: A project I am proud of
chapters.subtitle: 自己参与并感到自豪的项目

grammar.title: not only ... but also ...：递进并列
grammar.pattern: not only A but also B; Not only + inversion ...
grammar.note: 普通口语无需倒装；只在 Not only 置于句首时需要倒装。

examples.en: The community project involved not only planning but also practical work.
examples.zh: 这个社区项目不仅涉及规划，还包括实际动手。

examples.en: We had to consider not only accuracy but also user safety.
examples.zh: 我们不仅要考虑准确性，还得考虑用户安全。

examples.en: The experience wasn't just about technical skills; it also taught me leadership.
examples.zh: 这次经历不只是技术训练，也教会我领导能力。

examples.en: Did the project improve not only your coding skills but also your confidence?
examples.zh: 这个项目不仅提高了你的编程能力，也增强了你的自信吗？

examples.en: Not only did we build a working prototype, but we also documented the process.
examples.zh: 我们不仅做出了可运行原型，还记录了整个过程。

grammar.title: both / either / neither：两者逻辑
grammar.pattern: both A and B; either A or B; neither A nor B
grammar.note: both 肯定两者；either 任选一个；neither 两者都不；就近一致注意。

examples.en: Both the camera and the sensors played important roles.
examples.zh: 摄像头和传感器都发挥了重要作用。

examples.en: We could either simplify the design or extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们可以选择简化设计，或者延长截止时间。

examples.en: Neither option was perfect, so we tested both.
examples.zh: 两个方案都不完美，因此我们都测试了。

examples.en: Would you choose either research or product development, or try to combine them?
examples.zh: 你会选择研究或产品开发其中之一，还是尝试结合二者？

examples.en: I was responsible for both coordinating the team and reviewing the integration.
examples.zh: 我既负责协调团队，也负责检查系统集成。

grammar.title: 第二条件句：现在或未来的假设
grammar.pattern: If + past, would/could/might + V
grammar.note: 和真实的第一条件句区别：现在与将来的假设、不太确定的可能。

examples.en: If I had more time, I'd add another round of user testing.
examples.zh: 如果有更多时间，我会再加一轮用户测试。

examples.en: I wouldn't choose the most complicated model if a simpler one worked.
examples.zh: 如果简单模型就能达到要求，我不会选最复杂的。

examples.en: What would you change if you could redesign the prototype?
examples.zh: 如果能重新设计原型，你会改什么？

examples.en: If every team member worked independently, the integration would be a mess.
examples.zh: 如果每个组员都各做各的，系统集成会一团糟。

examples.en: I'd be more willing to take risks if the project were less time-sensitive.
examples.zh: 如果项目时间没那么紧，我会更愿意冒险尝试。

grammar.title: would rather / would prefer / prefer
grammar.pattern: would rather + V; would prefer to V; prefer V-ing to V-ing
grammar.note: would rather 后不用 to；prefer A to B 是对比长期偏好。

examples.en: I'd rather show a small working demo than a polished slide with no results.
examples.zh: 我宁愿展示一个能运行的小 demo，也不愿只拿出没结果的精美幻灯片。

examples.en: I'd prefer to test the system in a realistic setting.
examples.zh: 我更愿意在真实感更强的环境里测试系统。

examples.en: I'd rather not work alone on every single part of a project.
examples.zh: 我不愿意把项目的每一部分都独自完成。

examples.en: Would you prefer to lead a team or focus on the technical details?
examples.zh: 你更愿意带团队还是专注技术细节？

examples.en: In general, I prefer solving practical problems to discussing them endlessly.
examples.zh: 总体而言，比起无休止地讨论，我更喜欢解决实际问题。

grammar.title: 名词性结果表达：lead to / result in / enable
grammar.pattern: lead to + noun/V-ing; result in + noun; enable sb to V
grammar.note: 用比单纯 because...so... 更精确的因果；别过度名词化。

examples.en: Dividing the tasks clearly led to fewer misunderstandings.
examples.zh: 明确分工让误解变少了。

examples.en: The new design enabled us to test several settings more quickly.
examples.zh: 新设计让我们能更快测试多个设置。

examples.en: Better hardware doesn't automatically result in better user experience.
examples.zh: 更好的硬件不一定自动带来更好的用户体验。

examples.en: Can early feedback lead to a more reliable final product?
examples.zh: 早期反馈能带来更可靠的最终产品吗？

examples.en: Comparing the failures helped us identify the real source of the problem.
examples.zh: 对比失败案例帮我们找出了问题的真正根源。

questions: Describe a project you were proud to be part of.
What role did you play?
Why did it matter to you?
chapters.practice: 用一次团队项目讲清自己的角色、遇到的挑战、结果和反思。

chapters.title: A decision I had to make
chapters.subtitle: 选择、权衡与一次转折

grammar.title: unless / as long as / provided that
grammar.pattern: unless + clause; as long as + clause; provided that + clause
grammar.note: unless = if not；as long as / provided that = 条件满足就可以。

examples.en: I'll take on a new challenge as long as I have time to learn properly.
examples.zh: 只要有时间认真学习，我愿意接受新挑战。

examples.en: I wouldn't accept a job unless it offered room to grow.
examples.zh: 除非工作有成长空间，否则我不会接受。

examples.en: Would you change direction provided that the opportunity was right?
examples.zh: 如果机会合适，你会改变方向吗？

examples.en: You can make a sensible decision as long as you understand the trade-offs.
examples.zh: 只要理解利弊，就能做出理智的决定。

examples.en: I won't buy a more powerful computer unless I genuinely need it.
examples.zh: 除非真的需要，否则我不会买性能更强的电脑。

grammar.title: even if / even though：假设和事实
grammar.pattern: even if = 即使（假设）；even though = 尽管（事实）
grammar.note: 两者不能完全互换：even if it rains 是假设；even though it rained 是事实。

examples.en: I'd keep learning about AI even if I moved into a different industry.
examples.zh: 即使去了其他行业，我也会继续学习人工智能。

examples.en: Even though the first plan was reasonable, we eventually changed it.
examples.zh: 尽管最初的方案有道理，我们最终还是改了。

examples.en: I wouldn't change my mind even if someone disagreed strongly.
examples.zh: 即使有人强烈反对，我也不一定会改变想法。

examples.en: Would you take the risk even if success wasn't guaranteed?
examples.zh: 即使不保证成功，你还会冒这个险吗？

examples.en: Even though I had limited experience, I volunteered to coordinate the team.
examples.zh: 尽管经验有限，我仍主动协调团队。

grammar.title: as if / as though：看起来仿佛
grammar.pattern: seem/look as if + clause; talked as if...
grammar.note: 可说事实性的 as if，也可用过去式表达非事实、主观距离。

examples.en: The software behaved as if it had lost access to the network.
examples.zh: 软件的表现就像失去了网络连接。

examples.en: He explained the task as though everyone already knew the basics.
examples.zh: 他讲解任务时仿佛大家已经掌握基础一样。

examples.en: I didn't want to sound as if I knew everything.
examples.zh: 我不想显得自己好像什么都懂。

examples.en: Have you ever felt as though a difficult choice had no good answer?
examples.zh: 你有没有觉得某个艰难选择根本没有好答案？

examples.en: At first, it seemed as if we wouldn't finish before the deadline.
examples.zh: 一开始看起来我们似乎赶不上截止日期。

grammar.title: otherwise / or else：替代后果
grammar.pattern: Do X; otherwise, Y will... / X, or else Y...
grammar.note: 展示决策的必要性与结果；otherwise 可承接条件，不一定要 if。

examples.en: I backed up the dataset; otherwise, a system failure could have been disastrous.
examples.zh: 我备份了数据集，否则系统故障的后果可能很严重。

examples.en: We had to prioritise the essential features, or else we'd miss the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们必须优先做核心功能，否则会错过截止日期。

examples.en: I don't rush into expensive decisions; otherwise, I tend to regret them.
examples.zh: 我不会仓促做昂贵的决定，不然往往会后悔。

examples.en: Would you still go ahead, or would you choose another option?
examples.zh: 你还是会继续，还是会选另一种方案？

examples.en: We needed to clarify the requirements first; otherwise, the work might be wasted.
examples.zh: 我们得先明确需求，否则工作可能白做。

grammar.title: must/can't/might have done：过去推断
grammar.pattern: must have V3 / can't have V3 / might have V3
grammar.note: must have 是有较强证据的推断；can't have 是否定不可能。

examples.en: The file must have been overwritten during the update.
examples.zh: 文件肯定是在更新时被覆盖了。

examples.en: She can't have seen the message; her phone was switched off.
examples.zh: 她不可能看到消息，因为手机关机了。

examples.en: We might have underestimated the amount of testing required.
examples.zh: 我们可能低估了所需测试的工作量。

examples.en: Could the delay have been caused by a network problem?
examples.zh: 延误有没有可能是网络问题引起的？

examples.en: The team must have spent a great deal of time preparing the demonstration.
examples.zh: 团队肯定花了大量时间准备演示。

questions: Describe a difficult decision you made.
What options did you consider?
Would you decide differently now?

chapters.title: A skill I learned or taught
chapters.subtitle: 自学、分享与帮助他人

grammar.title: 完成式动名词 having done
grammar.pattern: regret/remember + having V3; after having V3
grammar.note: 强调动名词动作早于主句；口语中可选普通 doing，不必强塞复杂结构。

examples.en: I remember having struggled with the same concept before.
examples.zh: 我记得自己以前也被同一个概念难住过。

examples.en: After having tested several models, I became more careful about comparisons.
examples.zh: 测试过几个模型后，我做对比更加谨慎了。

examples.en: I don't regret having spent time on the fundamentals.
examples.zh: 我不后悔花时间打基础。

examples.en: Have you ever regretted not having asked for help sooner?
examples.zh: 你有没有后悔过没早点求助？

examples.en: Having learned the basics, I was ready to work on a practical example.
examples.zh: 学完基础后，我准备好动手做实际例子了。

grammar.title: 被动不定式与被动动名词
grammar.pattern: to be V3; being V3; having been V3
grammar.note: 在“需要被完成/避免被打断/被认可”等场景自然使用。

examples.en: The draft needs to be reviewed before submission.
examples.zh: 草稿提交前需要被检查。

examples.en: I don't like being interrupted when I'm explaining an idea.
examples.zh: 解释想法时我不喜欢被打断。

examples.en: The team appreciated being given enough time to experiment.
examples.zh: 团队很感激获得足够时间做实验。

examples.en: Is the new system ready to be demonstrated?
examples.zh: 新系统可以展示了吗？

examples.en: Having been corrected a few times, I began to notice the error myself.
examples.zh: 被纠正过几次之后，我开始自己注意到那个错误。

grammar.title: keep / end up / manage to / fail to
grammar.pattern: keep V-ing / end up V-ing / manage to V / fail to V
grammar.note: 讲学习过程中的坚持、结果、成败，贴近日常口语。

examples.en: I kept practising until the explanation sounded natural.
examples.zh: 我一直练习，直到说法听起来很自然。

examples.en: We ended up choosing a simpler solution than we'd planned.
examples.zh: 我们最终选了一个比原计划更简单的方案。

examples.en: I failed to notice a small typo in the script.
examples.zh: 我没注意到脚本里的一个小拼写错误。

examples.en: Did you manage to teach your friend how to use the tool?
examples.zh: 你成功教会朋友用那个工具了吗？

examples.en: The more I practised, the less I relied on memorised sentences.
examples.zh: 我练得越多，就越不依赖背好的句子。

grammar.title: 过去义务与不必：had to / didn't have to
grammar.pattern: had to V / didn't have to V / was supposed to V
grammar.note: 昨天“必须”不是 musted；didn't have to 与 mustn't 区分。

examples.en: I had to teach myself how to use a new software package.
examples.zh: 我不得不自学一套新软件。

examples.en: I didn't have to understand every detail before starting the demo.
examples.zh: 做 demo 前我并不需要理解每个细节。

examples.en: We were supposed to submit the files by Friday.
examples.zh: 我们原定要在周五前提交文件。

examples.en: Did you have to learn a new skill in a short period?
examples.zh: 你曾不得不在短时间内学会新技能吗？

examples.en: I wasn't supposed to share that unfinished version with anyone.
examples.zh: 我本来不该把那个未完成版本分享给别人。

grammar.title: 反问与回应：isn't it / don't you think...
grammar.pattern: ..., isn't it? / Don't you think that...?
grammar.note: 反问用于互动，而非考试套话；附加疑问句助动词与主句呼应。

examples.en: Explaining a concept to someone else is a good way to learn it, isn't it?
examples.zh: 把概念讲给别人听是很好的学习方式，不是吗？

examples.en: Don't you think practical examples make lessons more memorable?
examples.zh: 你不觉得实际例子让课堂更容易记住吗？

examples.en: You wouldn't expect a beginner to understand everything immediately, would you?
examples.zh: 你不会指望初学者一下子什么都懂，对吧？

examples.en: It's useful to ask questions, isn't it?
examples.zh: 多提问很有用，不是吗？

examples.en: I suppose the key is to practise consistently rather than occasionally.
examples.zh: 我想关键是持续练习，而不是偶尔练一次。

questions: Describe a useful skill you learned or taught.
How did you practise it?
How did you feel once you improved?

chapters.title: Education & how people learn
chapters.subtitle: 教育制度与学习方式

grammar.title: 泛指与限定：most / some / not all
grammar.pattern: Most + plural; Not all...; A minority of...
grammar.note: Part 3 避免“人人都……”的绝对判断；语法准确也体现观点严谨。

examples.en: Most students benefit from having some freedom to choose their modules.
examples.zh: 大多数学生都能从一定的选课自由中受益。

examples.en: Not all learners respond well to the same teaching method.
examples.zh: 并非所有学习者都适合同一种教学法。

examples.en: A small number of students may prefer highly structured lessons.
examples.zh: 少部分学生可能更喜欢结构严密的课堂。

examples.en: Do the majority of young people learn better through practice?
examples.zh: 大多数年轻人是否通过实践学得更好？

examples.en: Some skills are best acquired by making mistakes and correcting them.
examples.zh: 有些技能最适合通过犯错和纠错来习得。

grammar.title: the more..., the more...：双重比较
grammar.pattern: The + comparative ..., the + comparative ...
grammar.note: 双重比较表示相关变化，不一定是严格因果。

examples.en: The more opportunities students have to practise, the more confident they become.
examples.zh: 学生练习机会越多，就越自信。

examples.en: The earlier children develop reading habits, the easier independent learning becomes.
examples.zh: 孩子越早养成阅读习惯，自主学习就越容易。

examples.en: The more expensive a course becomes, the more carefully students should assess its value.
examples.zh: 课程费用越高，学生就越应该仔细评估它是否物有所值。

examples.en: Does the saying 'the more technology, the better the results' hold up in practice?
examples.zh: “技术越多，效果越好”这种说法在现实中站得住脚吗？

examples.en: The less time teachers spend on paperwork, the more attention they can give students.
examples.zh: 教师花在文书工作上的时间越少，就越能关注学生。

grammar.title: that 从句：判断、观点和证据
grammar.pattern: I believe (that)... / The fact that ... suggests...
grammar.note: that 作为内容从句引导词，口语有时可省；句子主干必须完整。

examples.en: I believe that students should learn how to evaluate information critically.
examples.zh: 我认为学生应该学会批判性地评估信息。

examples.en: I don't think that exam scores capture every aspect of a person's ability.
examples.zh: 我不认为考试分数能反映一个人所有能力。

examples.en: The fact that more courses include group work suggests priorities are changing.
examples.zh: 越来越多课程包含小组合作，这表明教育重点正在变化。

examples.en: Do you agree that creativity can be developed through education?
examples.zh: 你同意创造力能够通过教育培养吗？

examples.en: One concern is that students may rely too heavily on automated feedback.
examples.zh: 一个担忧是学生可能过度依赖自动反馈。

grammar.title: whether / if 名词性从句与 whether...or...
grammar.pattern: whether S + V; whether A or B
grammar.note: 正式名词性结构常用 whether；介词后通常用 whether，不用 if。

examples.en: Whether university is worthwhile depends partly on a student's goals.
examples.zh: 大学是否值得读，在一定程度上取决于学生的目标。

examples.en: Teachers need to consider whether a task measures understanding or memory.
examples.zh: 教师需要考虑某项任务测试的是理解还是记忆。

examples.en: I'm not sure whether online lessons can fully replace face-to-face discussion.
examples.zh: 我不确定线上课堂能否完全替代面对面的讨论。

examples.en: Does it matter whether students study at home or on campus?
examples.zh: 学生是在家还是在校园学习，这重要吗？

examples.en: Whether people choose a practical degree or an academic one, motivation matters.
examples.zh: 无论选实用型还是学术型学位，动力都很重要。

grammar.title: what / how / why 作名词性从句
grammar.pattern: What schools need is...; how people learn; why this matters
grammar.note: what 引导名词性从句并在从句内部充当成分；可作为句子的主题。

examples.en: What schools need is a better balance between exams and practical work.
examples.zh: 学校需要的是考试与实践之间更好的平衡。

examples.en: How students use feedback can be just as important as the feedback itself.
examples.zh: 学生如何利用反馈，可能和反馈本身同样重要。

examples.en: Why some pupils lose motivation isn't always obvious.
examples.zh: 一些学生为何失去动力，并不总是显而易见。

examples.en: What do you think matters more, curiosity or discipline?
examples.zh: 你觉得好奇心和自律哪个更重要？

examples.en: The real question is how we prepare young people for jobs that don't yet exist.
examples.zh: 真正的问题是如何帮助年轻人为尚不存在的职业做准备。

questions: Should university education be more practical?
Are exams an effective way to measure ability?
Will teachers become less important as technology improves?

chapters.title: Artificial intelligence & society
chapters.subtitle: AI、隐私与技术影响

grammar.title: although / even though：真实让步
grammar.pattern: Although S + V, main; even though S + V,...
grammar.note: 一句承认好处再指出风险，讨论更平衡，不要搭配 but 双连词。

examples.en: Although AI can speed up routine tasks, people still need to check its output.
examples.zh: 尽管人工智能能加快常规任务，人们仍须核查输出。

examples.en: Even though automation creates efficiencies, it can disrupt certain jobs.
examples.zh: 即使自动化提高效率，也可能冲击某些工作。

examples.en: AI isn't automatically trustworthy, although its answers may sound confident.
examples.zh: 即便回答听起来很自信，人工智能也不会因此自动变得可靠。

examples.en: Can people become too dependent on technology even though it makes life easier?
examples.zh: 即便科技让生活更方便，人们会不会过度依赖它？

examples.en: Although the software is powerful, its usefulness depends on the context.
examples.zh: 软件虽然强大，是否有用仍取决于具体情境。

grammar.title: while / whereas：并列对照
grammar.pattern: While A..., B... / A..., whereas B...
grammar.note: while 可表时间或对比；Part3 常用对比不同群体和利弊。

examples.en: While some people welcome smart assistants, others are concerned about privacy.
examples.zh: 有些人欢迎智能助手，另一些人却担忧隐私。

examples.en: A simple tool may save time, whereas a complex one can create extra work.
examples.zh: 简单工具可能省时，复杂工具反而可能增加工作量。

examples.en: Older people don't necessarily reject technology, while younger users aren't always cautious.
examples.zh: 年长者不一定排斥科技，年轻用户也不一定谨慎。

examples.en: Is it fair to say that employers benefit more, whereas workers face the risks?
examples.zh: 可以说雇主获益更多，而员工承担风险吗？

examples.en: While AI is good at processing information, human judgement remains important.
examples.zh: 人工智能擅长处理信息，但人的判断依然重要。

grammar.title: no matter how / what / where：无论
grammar.pattern: no matter how + adj; no matter what + clause
grammar.note: 讨论普遍原则；适合口语观点结尾，切勿每句话都升格为口号。

examples.en: No matter how accurate a model becomes, its limitations should be explained.
examples.zh: 不管模型多准确，都应该说明其局限。

examples.en: No matter what platform people use, their personal data deserves protection.
examples.zh: 无论使用哪个平台，个人数据都值得保护。

examples.en: No matter how advanced the technology is, it won't solve poor management.
examples.zh: 再先进的技术也无法解决糟糕的管理。

examples.en: Should children's data be protected no matter where they study?
examples.zh: 不论孩子在哪里学习，他们的数据都应该受到保护吗？

examples.en: No matter which profession someone enters, digital literacy will be valuable.
examples.zh: 无论从事哪种职业，数字素养都会很有价值。

grammar.title: whoever / whatever / whichever 自由关系从句
grammar.pattern: Whoever uses... / Whatever happens... / whichever is...
grammar.note: 代词本身在从句内起作用，口语用于泛指与选择。

examples.en: Whoever develops an AI service should take responsibility for how it is used.
examples.zh: 无论谁开发人工智能服务，都应该对其使用方式承担责任。

examples.en: Whatever the benefits are, the risks still need to be assessed.
examples.zh: 无论好处是什么，风险仍需评估。

examples.en: Whichever approach a company chooses, it shouldn't ignore user feedback.
examples.zh: 企业无论选哪条路线，都不该忽视用户反馈。

examples.en: Should whoever collects data be required to explain why they need it?
examples.zh: 收集数据的任何人是否都应被要求解释用途？

examples.en: People should be able to challenge whatever decision an automated system makes.
examples.zh: 人们应有权质疑自动化系统作出的任何决定。

grammar.title: 观点弱化与推测：tend to / seem to / be likely to
grammar.pattern: tend to V / seem to V / be likely to V
grammar.note: “并非必然”的表达能体现事实边界，也让观点更自然。

examples.en: People tend to trust tools that give clear explanations.
examples.zh: 人们往往更信任解释清楚的工具。

examples.en: New technology doesn't necessarily lead to better decisions.
examples.zh: 新技术不一定带来更好的决策。

examples.en: Smaller companies may be more likely to adopt ready-made AI services.
examples.zh: 小公司可能更倾向于采用现成的人工智能服务。

examples.en: Does AI seem likely to change how people learn languages?
examples.zh: 人工智能似乎会改变语言学习方式吗？

examples.en: The benefits appear to depend on how carefully the system is deployed.
examples.zh: 好处似乎取决于系统部署得有多谨慎。

questions: How might AI change the way people work?
Should people trust information produced by machines?
Who should be responsible when automated systems make mistakes?
