chapters.title: Climate, energy & sustainability
chapters.subtitle: 气候、能源与可持续生活

grammar.title: because / because of / due to：原因层级
grammar.pattern: because + clause; because of + noun; due to + noun
grammar.note: because of 后不要直接接完整句；因果链越清晰越好。

examples.en: Some households use more electricity because they rely heavily on air conditioning.
examples.zh: 一些家庭更耗电，因为高度依赖空调。

examples.en: Air quality may improve because of cleaner public transport.
examples.zh: 更清洁的公共交通可能改善空气质量。

examples.en: A product isn't sustainable simply because its packaging is green.
examples.zh: 产品包装是绿色的，并不意味着它就环保。

examples.en: Are energy bills rising mainly due to higher demand or higher costs?
examples.zh: 能源账单上涨主要是需求增加还是成本变高？

examples.en: I became interested in energy data through work on environmental reports.
examples.zh: 我通过参与环境报告相关工作，对能源数据产生了兴趣。

grammar.title: so that / in order that：表达目标
grammar.pattern: so that + S + can/could/will/would + V
grammar.note: 表目标而非结果；主句和从句要有清楚的目的关系。

examples.en: Cities should publish clearer information so that residents can compare options.
examples.zh: 城市应公布更清楚的信息，让居民能比较不同选择。

examples.en: We standardised the indicators so that the figures could be compared fairly.
examples.zh: 我们对指标进行标准化，以便公平地比较数据。

examples.en: Policies shouldn't be written so vaguely that nobody understands them.
examples.zh: 政策不该写得含糊到没人能理解。

examples.en: What can schools do so that children learn to reduce waste?
examples.zh: 学校可以做什么，才能让孩子学会减少浪费？

examples.en: Firms can track energy use carefully so that unnecessary consumption is noticed.
examples.zh: 企业可以仔细追踪能耗，从而发现不必要的消耗。

grammar.title: 零条件句：普遍规律与机制
grammar.pattern: If/When + present, present
grammar.note: 不是未来预测，而是惯常结果、规律或系统行为。

examples.en: If you leave lights on all night, you waste electricity.
examples.zh: 如果整晚开灯，就会浪费电。

examples.en: When buildings are poorly insulated, they lose heat quickly.
examples.zh: 建筑保温不好时，热量流失得很快。

examples.en: If data isn't reliable, the conclusions aren't reliable either.
examples.zh: 如果数据不可靠，结论也不可靠。

examples.en: What happens when a city produces more waste than it can process?
examples.zh: 城市产生的垃圾超过处理能力时会怎样？

examples.en: If people can see their energy use in real time, they often adjust their habits.
examples.zh: 如果能实时看到能耗，人们通常会调整习惯。

grammar.title: 被动报告结构：It is believed that...
grammar.pattern: It is often argued that... / X is believed to V
grammar.note: 传递他人观点同时保持距离；“据称”不是证据，注意来源。

examples.en: It is often argued that businesses should disclose more environmental data.
examples.zh: 常有人认为企业应该披露更多环境数据。

examples.en: Electric buses are generally considered quieter than diesel buses.
examples.zh: 电动公交通常被认为比柴油公交安静。

examples.en: It shouldn't be assumed that every green product has a lower overall impact.
examples.zh: 不能想当然认为每种绿色产品的总体影响都更小。

examples.en: Is it widely accepted that accurate reporting helps improve accountability?
examples.zh: 准确报告有助于提高问责性这一点是否得到广泛认可？

examples.en: Some energy-saving measures are thought to pay for themselves over time.
examples.zh: 有些节能措施被认为长期来看可以收回成本。

grammar.title: which 引导整句结果与非限定关系
grammar.pattern: main clause, which means / which makes...
grammar.note: which 指代整件事而非某个名词，便于自然解释后果。

examples.en: Many reports use different units, which makes comparison difficult.
examples.zh: 许多报告使用不同单位，这使比较变得困难。

examples.en: A city built more cycle lanes, which encouraged some residents to ride.
examples.zh: 一座城市增设了自行车道，这鼓励了一些居民骑行。

examples.en: The figures weren't independently checked, which raised concerns.
examples.zh: 数据未经独立核验，这引发了担忧。

examples.en: Could lower energy bills encourage better insulation, which would save more energy?
examples.zh: 更低的能耗账单能推动改善保温吗？那样会进一步节能。

examples.en: The database links each figure to a source, which improves traceability.
examples.zh: 数据库将每项数字关联到来源，这提高了可追溯性。

questions: Who should do more to reduce energy waste: individuals or companies?
Why do some environmental policies fail?
Can data make environmental reporting more reliable?

chapters.title: Cities, transport & housing
chapters.subtitle: 城市化、公共交通与居住

grammar.title: 虚拟语气：If I were / If cities were...
grammar.pattern: If + S + were..., S would...
grammar.note: 与目前情况不符的假设；正式或考试英语常用 If I were。

examples.en: If I were in charge of the city, I'd invest more in reliable buses.
examples.zh: 如果我负责城市管理，我会增加对可靠公交的投入。

examples.en: If housing were more affordable, young people wouldn't feel so much pressure.
examples.zh: 如果住房更实惠，年轻人的压力就不会这么大。

examples.en: What would you improve if you were the mayor for a day?
examples.zh: 如果你当一天市长，会改善什么？

examples.en: If the streets were safer for cyclists, more people might ride to work.
examples.zh: 如果街道对骑行者更安全，更多人可能骑车上班。

examples.en: I'd use the metro more often if the nearest station were closer.
examples.zh: 如果最近的地铁站更近，我会更常坐地铁。

grammar.title: 省略 if 的虚拟倒装：Were ... to ...
grammar.pattern: Were + S + to V, S would...
grammar.note: 高级可用，但口语中偏正式；自然聊天用 If...were to 同样好。

examples.en: Were a city to ban all cars overnight, many residents would struggle.
examples.zh: 假如城市一夜之间禁掉所有汽车，许多居民会不适应。

examples.en: Were public transport to become free, demand might rise sharply.
examples.zh: 如果公共交通免费，需求可能大增。

examples.en: Were the policy to change tomorrow, it wouldn't solve the problem immediately.
examples.zh: 即便政策明天改变，也不会立刻解决问题。

examples.en: Were the city to expand its metro network, would that change commuting habits?
examples.zh: 假如城市扩建地铁网络，会改变通勤习惯吗？

examples.en: Were I given a choice, I'd prioritise pedestrian safety.
examples.zh: 如果让我选，我会优先考虑行人安全。

grammar.title: would rather + 人 + 过去式：对别人行为的期望
grammar.pattern: I'd rather the city invested...
grammar.note: 与 I'd rather do 不同；I'd rather you didn't... 用过去式表达当前偏好。

examples.en: I'd rather the council invested in maintenance than flashy new buildings.
examples.zh: 我宁愿市政部门投资维护，也不愿建花哨的新楼。

examples.en: I'd rather people didn't park on narrow pavements.
examples.zh: 我希望人们不要把车停在狭窄的人行道上。

examples.en: Would you rather your neighbourhood had more shops or more green space?
examples.zh: 你更希望社区有更多商店还是更多绿地？

examples.en: I'd rather landlords provided clearer information about utility bills.
examples.zh: 我宁愿房东更清楚地说明水电账单。

examples.en: Many parents would rather their children walked to school safely.
examples.zh: 很多家长更希望孩子能安全步行上学。

grammar.title: compared with / unlike / in comparison
grammar.pattern: compared with + noun; unlike + noun; by comparison,...
grammar.note: 对比论证最好先说比较维度，避免跨对象比较。

examples.en: Compared with private cars, rail transport can move large numbers of people efficiently.
examples.zh: 与私家车相比，轨道交通能高效运送大量乘客。

examples.en: Unlike smaller towns, large cities can support frequent late-night services.
examples.zh: 不同于小城镇，大城市可以提供高频次深夜服务。

examples.en: By comparison, a remote neighbourhood may not have those options.
examples.zh: 相比之下，偏远社区可能没有这些选择。

examples.en: How does life in a large city compare with life in your hometown?
examples.zh: 大城市的生活与你家乡的生活相比如何？

examples.en: Compared with ten years ago, navigation apps make unfamiliar routes easier.
examples.zh: 与十年前相比，导航应用让陌生路线变得更容易。

grammar.title: 条件结果链：If...would..., meaning that...
grammar.pattern: If X happened, Y would..., meaning that Z...
grammar.note: Part 3 重要的是多层推理，而不只是堆复杂句。

examples.en: If buses ran more often, fewer people would need to drive, reducing congestion.
examples.zh: 如果公交更频繁，开车的人就会减少，从而缓解拥堵。

examples.en: If rents keep rising, workers may move farther away, which lengthens commutes.
examples.zh: 如果租金持续上涨，劳动者可能搬得更远，通勤时间随之拉长。

examples.en: If the system wasn't maintained, better design alone wouldn't prevent delays.
examples.zh: 如果缺乏维护，设计再好也不能避免晚点。

examples.en: Would people choose cycling if dedicated lanes made it feel safer?
examples.zh: 如果专用道让骑行更安全，人们会选择骑车吗？

examples.en: If local shops stay open later, the area could feel more lively after work.
examples.zh: 如果本地店铺营业到更晚，下班后街区可能更有活力。

questions: How should cities balance private cars and public transport?
What makes a city attractive to young people?
Will remote working reduce pressure on large cities?

chapters.title: Jobs, the economy & teamwork
chapters.subtitle: 就业、职场与经济变化

grammar.title: 介词 + which/whom 关系从句
grammar.pattern: the field in which... / people with whom...
grammar.note: 更正式的关系从句；口语可灵活说 the field I work in。

examples.en: The sector in which I hope to work is developing rapidly.
examples.zh: 我希望进入的行业正在迅速发展。

examples.en: The people with whom you work can shape your experience of a job.
examples.zh: 与你共事的人会影响你对工作的体验。

examples.en: This isn't an environment in which everyone can work effectively.
examples.zh: 这不是人人都能高效工作的环境。

examples.en: What qualities matter most in colleagues with whom you work closely?
examples.zh: 与你密切合作的同事，最重要的是具备哪些品质？

examples.en: The research institute at which I work focuses on environmental innovation.
examples.zh: 我所在的研究院专注于环境创新。

grammar.title: what = the thing(s) that：抽象主语
grammar.pattern: What employers value is...; What changes is...
grammar.note: 将讨论焦点放在观点而不是“I think...I think...”。

examples.en: What employers often value is the ability to learn independently.
examples.zh: 雇主通常看重的是独立学习能力。

examples.en: What makes teamwork difficult is a lack of clear communication.
examples.zh: 让团队合作变困难的是沟通不清。

examples.en: What workers need isn't always a higher salary alone.
examples.zh: 员工需要的不一定只有更高的薪水。

examples.en: What would make a graduate more employable?
examples.zh: 什么会让毕业生更有就业竞争力？

examples.en: What matters over the long term is whether employees can adapt to change.
examples.zh: 从长远看，重要的是员工能否适应变化。

grammar.title: 情态动词：现在推断 must / can't / might
grammar.pattern: must be / can't be / might be + adj / V-ing
grammar.note: 讨论政策与就业不必处处确定；must 是逻辑判断，不等于“必须”。

examples.en: A sudden shortage of skilled workers must be challenging for small firms.
examples.zh: 技术人才突然短缺对小公司来说肯定很棘手。

examples.en: Remote work can't be suitable for every profession.
examples.zh: 远程工作不可能适合所有职业。

examples.en: Some employees might be looking for flexibility rather than higher pay.
examples.zh: 一些员工可能更追求灵活性，而不是加薪。

examples.en: Could the rise of AI be changing how companies recruit?
examples.zh: 人工智能兴起是否正在改变企业招聘方式？

examples.en: A role that combines technical and communication skills is likely to remain valuable.
examples.zh: 结合技术与沟通能力的岗位很可能持续有价值。

grammar.title: in spite of / regardless of / despite
grammar.pattern: despite + noun/doing; regardless of + noun
grammar.note: Part 3 谈原则时，用 regardless of 指“无论是否”；注意介词后词形。

examples.en: Regardless of their background, graduates should have access to fair interviews.
examples.zh: 无论背景如何，毕业生都应该有公平的面试机会。

examples.en: Despite advances in technology, interpersonal skills remain essential.
examples.zh: 尽管技术进步，人际技能依然必不可少。

examples.en: In spite of earning a good salary, someone may still dislike their job.
examples.zh: 即便薪资不错，一个人仍可能不喜欢工作。

examples.en: Should employees be trained regardless of how long they've worked there?
examples.zh: 无论员工入职多久，都应该得到培训吗？

examples.en: Some people choose meaningful work despite the lower pay.
examples.zh: 有些人即使收入较低也会选择有意义的工作。

grammar.title: had better / be better off / might as well
grammar.pattern: had better + V / be better off V-ing / might as well + V
grammar.note: 用于权衡实际建议；had better 带较强后果意味。

examples.en: New graduates had better keep an open mind about their first job.
examples.zh: 应届毕业生最好对第一份工作保持开放心态。

examples.en: Some workers might be better off learning a new skill than changing firms immediately.
examples.zh: 一些员工学新技能可能比立刻跳槽更有利。

examples.en: Companies had better not rely on a single source of talent.
examples.zh: 企业最好不要依赖单一人才来源。

examples.en: Would people be better off working four longer days instead of five shorter ones?
examples.zh: 人们每周工作四个较长工作日，会比五个较短工作日更好吗？

examples.en: If the task is repetitive, you might as well automate part of it.
examples.zh: 如果任务总是重复，不妨把其中一部分自动化。

questions: Which skills will employers value most in the future?
Is a high salary more important than job satisfaction?
Should companies invest more in training graduates?

chapters.title: Governments, rules & ethics
chapters.subtitle: 政策、规范与公共责任

grammar.title: 建议式虚拟语气：that + 动词原形
grammar.pattern: recommend that S (should) + V; insist that S + V
grammar.note: 英式英语可保留 should；考口语别刻意全用，熟练表达即可。

examples.en: I'd recommend that schools teach students how to recognise misinformation.
examples.zh: 我建议学校教学生辨别虚假信息。

examples.en: Some experts propose that public services become more accessible online.
examples.zh: 一些专家建议公共服务在线上变得更易获取。

examples.en: I wouldn't insist that every business adopt the same reporting system.
examples.zh: 我不会坚持让所有企业采用相同的报告系统。

examples.en: Should governments require that companies explain how automated decisions are made?
examples.zh: 政府是否应要求企业解释自动化决策过程？

examples.en: It's important that the policy be evaluated using reliable evidence.
examples.zh: 政策使用可靠证据评估很重要。

grammar.title: It is essential/important that...
grammar.pattern: It is essential that S (should) V / be V3
grammar.note: 描述必要性；be 原形作正式虚拟语气，不是把 is 遗漏了。

examples.en: It is essential that users be informed about how their data is stored.
examples.zh: 用户必须被告知数据如何储存。

examples.en: It's important that every complaint be taken seriously.
examples.zh: 每一条投诉都得到认真对待很重要。

examples.en: It isn't necessary that every decision be made by a central authority.
examples.zh: 并非每项决定都必须由中央机构做出。

examples.en: Is it vital that public services remain accessible to older residents?
examples.zh: 公共服务必须始终便于年长居民使用吗？

examples.en: It is reasonable that young people should have a say in decisions affecting them.
examples.zh: 年轻人应对影响自身的决定有发言权，这是合理的。

grammar.title: only when / only if 置首引起倒装
grammar.pattern: Only when + clause + auxiliary + S + V
grammar.note: 句首 only + 状语触发主句倒装；自然口语用普通语序亦可。

examples.en: Only when the data is reliable can policymakers draw sensible conclusions.
examples.zh: 只有数据可靠，政策制定者才能得出合理结论。

examples.en: Only if the rules are clearly explained will most people follow them.
examples.zh: 只有规则解释清楚，多数人才会遵守。

examples.en: Only when mistakes are reported openly can they be properly addressed.
examples.zh: 只有错误被公开报告，才可能被妥善解决。

examples.en: Only if the costs are reasonable will the public support the scheme, won't they?
examples.zh: 只有成本合理，公众才会支持这个方案，对吗？

examples.en: Only after the trial ended did officials make the full results public.
examples.zh: 直到试验结束，官员才公布完整结果。

grammar.title: not until ... did：强调时间转折
grammar.pattern: Not until + time/clause + did + S + V
grammar.note: 倒装在主句而非 until 从句；可用较口语的 It wasn't until...that。

examples.en: Not until the figures were checked did the team spot the discrepancy.
examples.zh: 直到数字被核查，团队才发现不一致。

examples.en: It wasn't until the public complained that the issue gained attention.
examples.zh: 直到公众投诉，问题才受到关注。

examples.en: Not until a rule is enforced do some people take it seriously.
examples.zh: 有些人直到规则被执行才认真对待。

examples.en: Was it only after the accident that the standards were updated?
examples.zh: 是不是直到事故之后标准才得到更新？

examples.en: Not until people understand the reason behind a rule will they fully accept it.
examples.zh: 人们只有理解规则背后的原因，才会真正接受。

grammar.title: it is high time + 过去式：早该做
grammar.pattern: It's (high) time + S + past
grammar.note: 虽用过去式，表达现在“早该如此”，语气相对强。

examples.en: It's high time companies took digital privacy more seriously.
examples.zh: 企业早就该更认真地对待数字隐私。

examples.en: It's time schools updated some outdated assessment methods.
examples.zh: 学校该更新一些过时的考核方式了。

examples.en: I don't think it's time we abandoned traditional classrooms altogether.
examples.zh: 我不认为我们现在就该彻底放弃传统课堂。

examples.en: Is it time governments did more to improve accessible transport?
examples.zh: 政府是否该做更多工作来改善无障碍交通了？

examples.en: It's about time online platforms made their terms easier to understand.
examples.zh: 网络平台早就该把条款写得更好懂了。

questions: How should governments regulate emerging technologies?
Is it fair for companies to collect user data in exchange for services?
Should public policies be based mostly on expert advice?

chapters.title: Media, culture & globalisation
chapters.subtitle: 传统文化、媒体与全球化

grammar.title: however / nevertheless / on the other hand
grammar.pattern: sentence. However, sentence. / ...; nevertheless, ...
grammar.note: 连接副词与 but 语法位置不同；口语适度停顿即可。

examples.en: Online platforms expose people to new cultures. However, they can also encourage imitation.
examples.zh: 网络平台让人接触新文化，但也可能鼓励模仿。

examples.en: Global films are widely available; nevertheless, local stories still matter.
examples.zh: 全球电影很容易看到，但本土故事依然重要。

examples.en: Traditional crafts aren't always profitable. On the other hand, they have cultural value.
examples.zh: 传统工艺不一定赚钱，但有文化价值。

examples.en: Could online media strengthen local culture rather than weaken it?
examples.zh: 网络媒体能否增强而不是削弱本土文化？

examples.en: Some customs evolve naturally, whereas others disappear when communities change.
examples.zh: 有些习俗自然演变，另一些则随着社区变化消失。

grammar.title: neither ... nor ... 与否定副词倒装
grammar.pattern: Neither A nor B + V / Neither do I; Nor do I
grammar.note: neither...nor 两者都不；句首 Neither do I 为附和否定。

examples.en: Neither technology nor tourism can preserve a tradition on its own.
examples.zh: 科技和旅游都无法单独保存一项传统。

examples.en: I don't believe that every trend should be copied, and neither do my friends.
examples.zh: 我不认为每股潮流都该跟风，我朋友也不这么想。

examples.en: Neither of the two approaches guarantees long-term success.
examples.zh: 两种方法都不能保证长期成功。

examples.en: Is neither option attractive to younger audiences?
examples.zh: 难道两个选项都无法吸引年轻观众吗？

examples.en: Some visitors don't speak the local language, nor do they know the customs.
examples.zh: 一些游客既不会当地语言，也不了解习俗。

grammar.title: not so much A as B：不是A而是B
grammar.pattern: not so much A as B
grammar.note: 适合指出真正原因，带有修正和强调意味。

examples.en: The problem is not so much a lack of information as a lack of attention.
examples.zh: 问题与其说是缺信息，不如说是缺关注。

examples.en: Local festivals are not so much about spending money as about sharing time.
examples.zh: 本地节日与其说关乎花钱，不如说是共度时光。

examples.en: Cultural change isn't so much a threat as an opportunity to adapt.
examples.zh: 文化变化与其说是威胁，不如说是适应的机会。

examples.en: Is the issue not so much popularity as the quality of what people watch?
examples.zh: 问题是不是与其说在于热度，不如说在于内容质量？

examples.en: For me, travel is not so much about ticking off landmarks as understanding places.
examples.zh: 对我来说，旅行与其说是打卡景点，不如说是理解一个地方。

grammar.title: nominalisation：动词观点的名词化
grammar.pattern: improve → improvement; decide → decision; regulate → regulation
grammar.note: 名词化有助于抽象讨论，但英语口语仍要可听懂，别连续堆抽象名词。

examples.en: Better access to museums can encourage greater cultural participation.
examples.zh: 更便利的博物馆服务能够促进更多文化参与。

examples.en: The preservation of local dialects requires support from communities.
examples.zh: 保护地方方言需要社区支持。

examples.en: Rapid modernisation doesn't automatically mean the loss of every tradition.
examples.zh: 快速现代化并不必然意味着所有传统消失。

examples.en: What role does education play in the transmission of cultural knowledge?
examples.zh: 教育在文化知识传承中扮演什么角色？

examples.en: Greater exposure to different viewpoints may reduce unnecessary stereotypes.
examples.zh: 更多接触不同观点可能减少不必要的刻板印象。

grammar.title: 同位语 that 从句：抽象观念的内容
grammar.pattern: the idea that... / the belief that... / the claim that...
grammar.note: the idea that... 的 that 不是关系代词，而是解释“具体是什么想法”。

examples.en: I like the idea that technology can help preserve oral histories.
examples.zh: 我喜欢“技术可以帮助保存口述历史”这个想法。

examples.en: The belief that young people dislike tradition seems too simplistic.
examples.zh: 认为年轻人不喜欢传统的观点显得过于简单。

examples.en: I don't accept the claim that globalisation always destroys local identity.
examples.zh: 我不接受全球化总会摧毁本土认同的说法。

examples.en: Is there any evidence for the idea that reading habits are declining?
examples.zh: 有证据证明阅读习惯正在衰退这一观点吗？

examples.en: The assumption that everyone consumes the same media ignores real differences.
examples.zh: 假定人人都消费同样的媒体，忽视了真实差异。

questions: Does globalisation weaken local culture?
How can young people keep traditions alive?
Can online media improve access to the arts?

chapters.title: The future of society & technology
chapters.subtitle: 未来社会、科技和人生选择

grammar.title: 将来完成时表达社会变化的预测
grammar.pattern: By + future time, will have V3
grammar.note: 讨论未来时间节点的结果；具体时点要清楚，避免空泛“未来将已经……”。

examples.en: By 2040, many cities will have expanded their public transport networks.
examples.zh: 到2040年，许多城市将已扩建公共交通网络。

examples.en: Within a decade, AI tools may have changed the way offices organise routine work.
examples.zh: 十年之内，人工智能工具可能已改变办公室安排日常工作的方式。

examples.en: We won't have eliminated traffic jams simply by improving navigation apps.
examples.zh: 仅改进导航应用并不能让我们彻底消灭堵车。

examples.en: Will schools have redesigned their assessments by the time today's children graduate?
examples.zh: 现在的孩子毕业时，学校是否已重新设计考核？

examples.en: By the next generation, some jobs will have disappeared while new ones emerge.
examples.zh: 到下一代人时，一些工作将已消失，同时又有新职业出现。

grammar.title: 将来进行时表达社会常态
grammar.pattern: will be V-ing; may be V-ing
grammar.note: 与将来完成对照：描述未来某时正在发生/持续的行为，不强调完成。

examples.en: In twenty years, people may be commuting in ways we can't easily imagine.
examples.zh: 二十年后，人们的通勤方式可能是我们今天难以想象的。

examples.en: More doctors will be using digital tools to support routine diagnosis.
examples.zh: 更多医生将使用数字工具辅助常规诊断。

examples.en: People won't necessarily be working from the same office every day.
examples.zh: 人们不一定每天都在同一间办公室工作。

examples.en: What kinds of skills will graduates be learning in the 2030s?
examples.zh: 2030年代的毕业生将学习哪些技能？

examples.en: As populations age, cities will be adapting their services to older residents.
examples.zh: 随着人口老龄化，城市将不断调整服务以适应年长居民。

grammar.title: rarely / seldom / hardly 句首倒装
grammar.pattern: Rarely do S V...; Seldom have S V3...
grammar.note: 倒装较书面；Part3 点到为止，不能为了“高级”牺牲语气自然性。

examples.en: Rarely do major technological changes affect every group in exactly the same way.
examples.zh: 重大技术变革很少会以完全相同的方式影响所有群体。

examples.en: Seldom have people had access to so much information.
examples.zh: 人们很少像现在这样能够获取如此大量的信息。

examples.en: Hardly anyone can predict exactly how the job market will look in twenty years.
examples.zh: 几乎没人能准确预测二十年后就业市场的样子。

examples.en: Do people rarely question the reliability of automated recommendations?
examples.zh: 人们是否很少质疑自动推荐的可靠性？

examples.en: Never before has learning a technical skill been quite so accessible online.
examples.zh: 在线学习技术技能从未像现在这样便捷。

grammar.title: 复杂虚拟：现在结果与过去条件
grammar.pattern: If S had V3, S would V now; If S were..., would have V3
grammar.note: 混合条件句只有在时间关系明确时才自然，否则简单句更好。

examples.en: If remote work hadn't spread so widely, many companies would be less flexible today.
examples.zh: 如果远程工作当时没有如此普及，许多公司今天就不会这么灵活。

examples.en: If people were less dependent on cars, cities might have developed differently.
examples.zh: 如果人们没那么依赖汽车，城市过去可能会以另一种方式发展。

examples.en: We wouldn't be discussing these issues now if technology hadn't advanced so quickly.
examples.zh: 如果技术没有发展得这么快，我们现在可能不会讨论这些问题。

examples.en: Would society be better prepared if schools had taught digital literacy earlier?
examples.zh: 如果学校更早教数字素养，社会今天会准备得更充分吗？

examples.en: If environmental data had been more accessible, some decisions might be easier now.
examples.zh: 如果环境数据过去更易获取，如今某些决定可能会更容易。

grammar.title: 综合：让步 + 假设 + 判断 + 结果
grammar.pattern: While A..., if B..., C might..., which...
grammar.note: 7.5/8 目标是自然灵活，不是每句 40 词；复杂结构和准确简单句交替。

examples.en: While automation may replace some tasks, it could also create new roles if people receive proper training.
examples.zh: 虽然自动化可能替代某些任务，但如果人们获得适当培训，也可能创造新岗位。

examples.en: If governments invest in cleaner transport, cities may become more liveable, which benefits everyone.
examples.zh: 如果政府投资清洁交通，城市可能更宜居，这对所有人都有益。

examples.en: Even if AI becomes more powerful, it won't remove the need for human judgement.
examples.zh: 即使人工智能能力更强，也不会消除人类判断的必要性。

examples.en: Given how quickly technology changes, should schools focus more on adaptable skills?
examples.zh: 考虑到技术变化这么快，学校是否应该更重视可迁移技能？

examples.en: What matters most isn't predicting the future perfectly, but building systems that can adapt when things change.
examples.zh: 最重要的不是完美预测未来，而是建立能随变化调整的系统。

questions: What might everyday life look like in twenty years?
Which changes should society prepare for now?
Is it useful to make long-term predictions about technology?

supplements.title: 通用版使用说明
supplements.subtitle: 用通用情境练结构，再换成自己的事实
supplements.body: 本书所有第一人称例句均为通用练习情境，不代表读者或任何真实个人的经历。身份、地点、学校与项目已改写为通用表达。先练通语法和口语，再用自己的真实经历变形。想获得整套个人化例句，可以使用 iSpeak Personal Speaking skill。

supplements.title: 四步开口法
supplements.subtitle: 理解 → 跟读 → 变形 → 自己说
supplements.body:
看英文，从语境理解意思，再看中文。
读三遍：慢读、按意群读、像回答真人一样读。
变三次：换人物、换时间、换事实，再试否定和疑问。
说整段：用自己的真实经历回答问题，复盘一处可以修正的语法。
例句是结构训练材料，不需要把情境练习当成真实经历。

supplements.title: 12 时态速练 · 1
supplements.subtitle: 肯定、否定、疑问对照
supplements.body:
REFERENCE B
12 种常见英语时态 · 三种句式速练
核心不是把“12 时态”在每题轮一遍，而是在叙事时正确选择时间位置（现在/过去/将来）与观察角度（简单/进行/完成/完成进行）。将来表达还包括
going to 和已安排的现在进行时，见 G031–G035。
T01 Present simple 习惯、事实
肯 I review notes.
否 I don't review notes on Fridays.
问 Do you review your notes?
T02 Present continuous 此刻/暂时
肯 I'm reviewing a paper.
否 I'm not reviewing it now.
问 Are you reviewing the report?
T03 Present perfect 现在相关结果
肯 I've finished the draft.
否 I haven't finished it yet.
问 Have you finished the draft?
T04 Present perfect continuous 持续到现在
肯 I've been studying all morning.
否 I haven't been studying long.
问 Have you been studying?
T05 Past simple 结束的过去
肯 I emailed the supervisor.
否 I didn't email him yesterday.
问 Did you email the supervisor?
T06 Past continuous 过去某时进行
肯 I was testing the code.
否 I wasn't testing it then.
问 Were you testing the code?

supplements.title: 12 时态速练 · 2
supplements.subtitle: 肯定、否定、疑问对照
supplements.body:
T07 Past perfect 过去的过去
肯 I'd checked the results.
否 I hadn't checked them.
问 Had you checked the results?
T08 Past perfect continuous 过去时点前的持续
肯 I'd been waiting for an hour.
否 I hadn't been waiting long.
问 Had you been waiting long?
T09 Future simple 承诺/即兴决定/预测
肯 I'll call you later.
否 I won't call during class.
问 Will you call tonight?
T10 Future continuous 未来某时进行
肯 I'll be working tomorrow.
否 I won't be working then.
问 Will you be working tomorrow?
T11 Future perfect 未来截止前完成
肯 I'll have finished by noon.
否 I won't have finished by noon.
问 Will you have finished by noon?
T12 Future perfect continuous 未来截至时的持续时长
肯 By noon, I'll have been working for six hours.
否 I won't have been working for six hours by noon.
问 Will you have been working for six hours by noon?
区分三个“将来”：I will check（现在决定 / 承诺）；I am going to check（已有打算）；I am meeting her on Friday（安排已定）。另外，固
定车次/营业时间也常用一般现在时：The train leaves at nine.

supplements.title: 高频口语语法错误 · 1
supplements.subtitle: 45 个错误 · 错句 → 对句
supplements.body:
REFERENCE C
45 个高频口语语法错误：错句 → 对句
建议每天只挑 3–5 条，先故意辨认哪里错，再把正确版本大声说 5 遍。比一次性看完全部更有用。
01. ✕ I am study biology.
✓ I study biology. / I'm studying biology.
be 动词后不能直接接实义动词原形；区分事实与进行。
02. ✕ He don't like it.
✓ He doesn't like it.
第三人称单数助动词用 doesn't。
03. ✕ Does she likes maths?
✓ Does she like maths?
does 后动词回原形。
04. ✕ There have many parks.
✓ There are many parks.
存在句用 there are。
05. ✕ I have an advice.
✓ I have some advice.
advice 不可数。
06. ✕ The information are useful.
✓ The information is useful.
information 不可数，谓语单数。
07. ✕ I very like this neighbourhood.
✓ I really like this neighbourhood.
very 通常不能直接修饰动词。
08. ✕ more better
✓ much better
比较级不重复。
09. ✕ She is more tall than me.
✓ She's taller than me.
tall 用 -er 构成比较级。
10. ✕ I am agree.
✓ I agree.
agree 是实义动词。
11. ✕ I am knowing the answer.
✓ I know the answer.
know 一般是状态动词。
12. ✕ I have visited Shanghai last year.
✓ I visited Shanghai last year.
明确结束时间通常用过去时。
13. ✕ I have came here.
✓ I have come here.
现在完成时是 have + V3。

supplements.title: 高频口语语法错误 · 2
supplements.subtitle: 45 个错误 · 错句 → 对句
supplements.body:
14. ✕ I haven't never tried it.
✓ I've never tried it.
never 不与 haven't 叠加否定。
15. ✕ I have learned English since three years.
✓ I've been learning English for three years.
时长用 for，起点用 since。
16. ✕ I didn't went to class.
✓ I didn't go to class.
didn't 后用原形。
17. ✕ When I was child...
✓ When I was a child...
单数可数名词通常要冠词。
18. ✕ I used to going there.
✓ I used to go there.
过去常常是 used to V。
19. ✕ I'm used to study alone.
✓ I'm used to studying alone.
习惯于 = be used to V-ing。
20. ✕ If it will rain, I'll stay in.
✓ If it rains, I'll stay in.
第一条件句 if 从句通常用现在时。
21. ✕ If I would have known...
✓ If I'd known...
第三条件句 if + had V3。
22. ✕ If I was you...
✓ If I were you...
非事实建议常用 were。
23. ✕ I wish I will know it earlier.
✓ I wish I'd known it earlier.
对过去遗憾用 wish + had V3。
24. ✕ The problem should be solve.
✓ The problem should be solved.
情态动词被动 should be V3。
25. ✕ The road is repairing.
✓ The road is being repaired.
主语承受动作时用被动进行式。
26. ✕ I had my laptop repair.
✓ I had my laptop repaired.
have + 物 + V3。
27. ✕ I enjoy to read.
✓ I enjoy reading.
enjoy 后用 doing。

supplements.title: 高频口语语法错误 · 3
supplements.subtitle: 45 个错误 · 错句 → 对句
supplements.body:
28. ✕ I want improving my English.
✓ I want to improve my English.
want + to V。
29. ✕ He made me to change it.
✓ He made me change it.
make sb V（主动）。
30. ✕ My teacher let me to try.
✓ My teacher let me try.
let sb V（主动）。
31. ✕ The person which helped me...
✓ The person who helped me...
指人用 who/that。
32. ✕ The city where I live in...
✓ The city where I live... / the city I live in...
where 与介词不重复。
33. ✕ My hometown, that is in the north...
✓ My hometown, which is in the north...
非限定从句不用 that。
34. ✕ Do you know where is it?
✓ Do you know where it is?
间接疑问句陈述语序。
35. ✕ She told to me the news.
✓ She told me the news.
tell sb sth，不要 tell to sb。
36. ✕ Because I was busy, so I stayed in.
✓ Because I was busy, I stayed in.
because 和 so 不双用。
37. ✕ Although it rained, but we went.
✓ Although it rained, we went.
although 和 but 不双用。
38. ✕ Despite it was raining...
✓ Although it was raining... / Despite the rain...
despite 后不直接接完整句。
39. ✕ This makes me to feel better.
✓ This makes me feel better.
make + sb + 原形。
40. ✕ Every students have a plan.
✓ Every student has a plan.
every + 单数名词和单数谓语。
41. ✕ I prefer tea than coffee.
✓ I prefer tea to coffee.
prefer A to B。

supplements.title: 高频口语语法错误 · 4
supplements.subtitle: 45 个错误 · 错句 → 对句
supplements.body:
42. ✕ A good environment is more important as salary.
✓ A good environment is more important than salary.
比较级 + than。
43. ✕ Only when we test it we know.
✓ Only when we test it do we know.
only 状语置于句首，主句部分倒装。
44. ✕ It's high time we take action.
✓ It's high time we took action.
it's high time + 过去式。
45. ✕ The more you practise, you become better.
✓ The more you practise, the better you become.
the more..., the more... 完整对应。
